Friend, **We have a Left-wing movement in this country that is fundamentally hostile to the rights of parents.__** If the Left is actively fighting parental involvement in schools and shutting them off from knowing the curriculum, it is because they have something to hide. **They are worried that parents will stand in the way of their mission to turn education into indoctrination.** **_We should not have stories of whistleblowers coming forward to expose the inappropriate material --littered with hardcore pornography and pedophilia--filling school libraries._** While the media allows the Left to push the narrative that we're "banning books," that's not even close. In Florida, you can buy any book you want. What we are doing is making a judgment call about what's appropriate in elementary school libraries and we are not using tax dollars to bring in that type of material into our schools. Meanwhile, Biden has created a federal "porn enforcer" to try and stop state leaders like me from protecting children and keeping schools clean. **That is fundamentally wrong.** They're not "your" kids, Biden. As a father, I don't want my 6, 5, and 3-year-olds seeing this garbage.

## Why Is American Christianity Struggling?
---
**American Churches** were once _booming_ like many _boom towns_ in our nation's history. Unfortunately, the trend now for many American Churches is not the boom town experience but more like a _ghost town_... Did you know that twelve churches per day in America **close down**? Church attendance is at an **all time low**. In 1972 around 92%of Americans identified as Christian, whereas in 2020 that number dropped to 64%. **Why is American Christianity struggling?** Last Sunday, at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.58.1.06b61a86a219e009e0b0439bbaa7b2f2) OKC & Tulsa, I addressed that question and how a church can **BOOM**. We have seen the **BOOM** experince at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.59.1.15868d69c0ed5fd4a19663a73c17b66e) in all categories: reach, influence, attendance & finances. There are **four primary reasons** that [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.60.1.03cd95441a6efa59b6d6b188e16ca409) has boomed and they are found in **Acts 2:42**. This message will bless you and your local church! Watch here: [https://www.youtube.com/live/YCcVTz88FMo?feature=share](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.61.1.eab61575da149eef60b6f41640469a3b) Thank you,

---

---
When it comes to the history of the United States of America, we have been _intentionally_ not told the entire story.
Our Founding Father's are demonized in public school history classes and we are told by "_leaders_ " like Barak Hussein Obama that America was not founded as a Christian Nation.
This last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.71.1.d9ba336c491f5ea6556fdce1f35a5675) in OKC & Tulsa, I spoke on a subject matter that I am passionate about. I recioeved a B.A. & M.A. from Oral Roberts University in Theological & Historical Studies (much of which covered the history of America).
In this message, I tell the [TRUE story of America](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.72.1.e29d582b5105d49aac1129a90cc153ab).
It will bless and encourage you.

## The Gay & Trans Agenda
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.75.1.2f490d9262604926aa3f6943dfa1919e)
---
On Friday, two weeks ago, I announced I was taking our church where few churches would dare to go by addressing the **Gay & Trans Agenda** in America.
Last night in **Tulsa** something like we have never seen took place.
Instead of a tornado coming through which carves a path of destruction in a town or city, the **entire** Tulsa Metro was hit with destructive **winds over 100mph** and the vast majority of the city lost power.
It was as if the enemy did not want a certain message being broadcast out from Tulsa...
Fortunately, we had power at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.76.1.913e06ade3ec3015f0e2087120da4c71) for both our 9 & 11am services even though the businesses around us did not. However, our internet service was _unavailable_ and our services were not streamed live.
Thankfully the services were recorded since we had power and the message is now available to be seen across America.
Here is last week's message: **[The Gay& Trans Agenda In America](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.77.1.0b4fe56bae4bc4207cbcf500ccfd1386)**
Watch here: [https://youtu.be/U-Rkn14_hGM](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=12460.78.1.645a11eefb305515086ae76f81dab124)

subject: Kennedy Democrats Endorse Joe Biden
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/KD_Logo.png]
Kennedy Democrats Announce Enthusiastic Endorsement of President Joe Biden’s Reelection Campaign
Progressive Democratic group announces endorsement as a rival presidential candidate seizes the Kennedy Democrat moniker at campaign events
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM%20and%20Biden.jpeg]
BUCKS COUNTY, PA – Kennedy Democrats, a progressive political organization dedicated to building infrastructure for the state by electing Democrats up and down the ballot in Pennsylvania, released the following statement endorsing President Biden after a challenger appropriated the organization’s name while on the stump.
Scott Wallace, who co-founded Kennedy Democrats alongside former Congressman and Army Under Secretary Patrick Murphy, stated the following about their unequivocal support for President Biden to get a second term next year:
“To be clear, Kennedy Democrats 100 percent supports the reelection of President Joe Biden. Though our organization's name has recently been invoked as a slogan for a candidate seeking to defeat President Biden, we believe President Biden has produced a spectacular record of accomplishment, much of it through strong bipartisan legislative consensus, delivering huge tangible benefits for everyday Americans. Most recently, his leadership saved us -- and the world economy -- from the catastrophic effects of a default on our national debt, and the Supreme Court's head-spinning judicial activism in decimating the rights and freedoms of Americans reminds us of the extraordinarily high stakes in next November's elections. Our nation desperately needs to continue this leadership to strengthen our economy, responsibly balance spending and revenues, and protect our freedoms and our planet. To us, President Biden categorically deserves reelection.
Kennedy Democrats remain united with our friends in our commitment to elect progressive Democrats in Pennsylvania in the mold of JFK, his two brothers who served in the US Senate, and other Kennedys in the US House."
Kennedy Democrats launched in 2019 to elect a new generation of Democrats outside of Philadelphia and Pittsburgh and deepen the political bench for Pennsylvania. The group has raised hundreds of thousands of dollars for candidates across Pennsylvania and will continue supporting candidates in addition to President Joe Biden in next year’s election.

subject: 2024 is the time to put up or shut up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I will never stop standing up for what I know is right--even when it goes against the grain of public opinion.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c28982%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hE4rYtxUMTJzvrBpa1gFvA&sysid=1)

Friend, **The time for chirping from the sidelines is over.** Talk is ineffective, and that’s why my message has been simple: **2024 is the time to put up or shut up**. As a leader, your job is to put the interests of the people you serve above your own political gain. I’ve done that in Florida, and I’ve watched the American people cry out for real leadership nationwide. I will never stop standing up for what I know is right--even when it goes against the grain of public opinion. The American people deserve a President with a track record of taking action and standing for what’s right. The lack of action from our leaders across this country has gone on for far too long. Joe Biden has done more to damage our nation than anyone, and Kamala Harris has done nothing at all. I am DONE hearing excuses. If Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it’s time we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the playbook for defeating the woke mob:
* Giving parents back their voice in the classroom by BANNING CRT and pornographic content for young kids

* STANDING UP against woke corporations who have tried to force taxpayers to fund an ESG agenda

* DEFEATING Faucism and giving back Floridians the freedom to breathe and see their families after the elites in DC shut down the country

I’m tired of seeing Republicans lose. _A_ _ren’t you, Friend_ _?_ I promise you, with me as your candidate and President, Republicans will forget this culture of losing once and for all. To make sure we’re able to achieve this, I am asking for your continued support. **[If you can, will you pitch in?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c28983%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fw5v5w6QaFEOW3%2b8ZgacaA&sysid=1 "If you can, will you pitch
in?")**

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c28992%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZeUso7qDHkYfOQe9rSxpDA&sysid=1)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

A ren’t you, Friend ? I promise you, with me as your candidate and President, Republicans will forget this culture of losing once and for all. To make sure we’re able to achieve this, I am asking for your continued support. "If you can, will you pitch in?" | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | The time to act is now. The time for leadership is now. 2024 is going to be the year that our Great American Comeback takes shape. Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for. We will fight back and WIN. I am humbly asking for your support today, Friend. Join me, and we will put an end to the culture of losing that has surrounded the Republican party. We will keep the woke indoctrination away from kids, the way we live our lives, the curriculum taught in schools, and the consumer choices we make. | | Our Great American Comeback is attainable as long as we’re willing to fight for it. In Freedom, | Ron DeSantis | | | Meet Ron DeSantis | | | | | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Fwd: Please HELP: Ohio is in a Constitutional Crisis of Epic Proportions
body:
Hello Shelby County Conservatives,

Ohio is facing the most serious threat to conservative principles any of us
have ever seen!

Bold claim, yes, but if you read this email, I’m confident you will agree
and you will want to fight with all the energy you can muster! We are in
crisis mode!

Planned Parenthood and the ACLU are swinging for the fences this Summer and
Fall in Ohio! They just, today, turned in 710,131 signatures to get a
constitutional amendment on the ballot in November. Statistically, it
looks like a sure thing it will be on the November ballot now.

This email will outline our critical fight ahead, which includes a MUST-WIN
election in August. Planned Parenthood and the ACLU are well funded and
highly motivated to take over our state’s constitution. We must FIGHT NOW
like our lives depended on it!!!

If we don’t get the conservative vote out in the next two elections (August
8th and November 7th), we stand to lose so much ground to the ultra-liberal
left that it is hard to imagine that our state could ever recover from it.
Let me set the stage for you.

There are three major facets to this crisis that we need to fight (mostly)
in sequence:

1. Protect our constitution from leftist, liberal, out-of-state meddlers in
the August Election

- See the <August Amendment Explained> attachment to better understand
this

2. Defeat Planned Parenthood and the ACLU’s unbelievably bad constitutional
amendment in the November Election

- See the <November Amendment Explained> attachment to better understand
this

3. Hold Republican politicians accountable for creating this crisis

- We need to focus on winning in August for now, but the accountability
discussion must follow

A WARNING about AUGUST: If we fail to protect our constitution in August,
our ability to defeat Planned Parenthood and the ACLU in November will be
severely compromised. The attachments will make that relationship clear to
you. Bottom Line: It is ALL-HANDS-ON-DECK for this August election.

I often hear parents and grand-parents fret about the future in store for
their children and grand-children. Transgenderism and the alphabet-soup of
child-sexualization is out of control in our nation. This is a do-or-die
moment in Ohio if we want to preserve any semblance of a reasonable future
for our children and grandchildren. There is so much to be said about the
threats we face that I could easily overwhelm you, so I will try to keep it
manageable. I am making bold claims in this email, but I believe the
attachments will convince you that my claims are well founded. They will
also help fill in some of the blanks if you want/need more detail about
specific aspects of this battle.

How can you help?

Please be creative in deciding how you will help us win in August and
November. At this stage of the battle, it really boils down to us getting
more votes than them! That means we must do three things better than we
have ever done them before in Shelby County, and pray that other counties
are doing the same:

*1. Voter Awareness*

- The vast majority of voters don’t even know we’re having an election
in August, let alone how important it is.
- Please be creative in how you make people aware, but every
conservative voter in Ohio needs to be made aware of this impending
crisis. Emails, texts, phone calls, church bulletins, social media posts,
FaceBook profiles, letters to the editor, etc.
- Tell people about the importance of this election every way that
you can think of.
- Please see the attached <Yard Sign Strategy> for another very
important mechanism for raising awareness.

*2. Voter Education*

- The liberal left is masterful at confusing people with half-truths and
outright lies. Please see the <4 Big Lies> attachment. Please also see
the companion article attached as <Amendments *Should* Be Hard>.
- We need to educate our voters so they “Vote YES on Issue 1” in the
August Special Election. Two good sources are:
- VoteYesOhio.com
- ProtectWomenOhio.com

*3. Voter Turnout*

- Shelby County had less than 14% turnout in last year’s August
Election.
- Conservative counties like ours need record-breaking turnout this
August to avert this crisis.
- And PLEASE VOTE EARLY!!! August is a busy, busy time for families.
PLEASE get your vote in the bank ASAP!!!
- My family will be voting the week of July 11th and I am offering
rides to my neighbors at Dorothy Love to go vote early.
- The early in-person voting schedule at the Board of Elections is
attached. <Early Voting Hours>
- You could also request an absentee ballot and mail it in by
following the link below:
-
https://www.ohiosos.gov/elections/voters/how-to-request-your-absentee-ballot/
- Early voting can help us win! Please do it!!!

If you need signs, please stop by the Shelby County Square on Saturday
mornings, or just contact me!

If you have ideas about how to help us win these battles, please don’t
hesitate to contact me! Simply informing everyone you know and getting
them to vote early and to “Vote YES on Issue 1” will be a tremendous help!!!

Please consider forwarding this to every conservative Ohio voter in your
email address book!!!

Please be praying that God’s will be done in this matter, and that His
people rise to the occasion!

Let’s win this!!!

Soli Deo Gloria...Dan Cecil
Chairman, Shelby County Republican Party
(937) 206-2970
cecilda.usaf@gmail.com

Attachments:
<August Amendment Explained>
<November Amendment Explained>
<Yard Sign Strategy>
<4 Big Lies>
Source:
https://www.buckeyefirearms.org/4-big-lies-opponents-spreading-about-ohio-issue-1
<Amendments Should Be Hard>
Source:
https://www.buckeyefirearms.org/issue-1-why-ohios-constitution-should-be-hard-amend
<Early Voting Hours>
Source:
https://www.boe.ohio.gov/shelby/c/upload/Election_EarlyVotingHours.pdf

--
Dan Cecil
(937) 206-2970
cecilda.usaf@gmail.com

The Southern Resident orca population is at one of its lowest points in decades, and these magnificent creatures are on the**BRINK OF EXTINCTION. **
**First:** New orca mother Tahlequah mourned her baby when it died just thirty minutes after being born, carrying its body over 1,000 miles in her grief before letting go.
**Then:** Playful Cappuccino, Marina the matriarch, and young Ripple died from starvation -- deaths that their families are still grieving.
**Now:** Two new orcas were just born, **_but they are already in extreme danger of starving to death._**
Only 75 orcas are left in the Southern Resident pods -- and 13 of them are in dire straits as they were recently deemed “vulnerable” due to their astonishingly poor physical condition. But a new shipping terminal and oil pipeline expansion threaten the remaining whales, their entire ecosystems, and the communities who live nearby. Just one oil spill could completely wipe out the last remaining orcas -- including these new babies.

[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1875637?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
We need your help to save majestic orcas and their beautiful ocean habitats. We’re doing everything we can to stop Big Oil from polluting our oceans and coastal communities and driving climate change, but we need your help now.
Every dollar you give before midnight tonight will be MATCHED to meet our $90,000 World Orca Day goal and continue this critical work. Rush a membership donation now and have it go TWICE AS FAR to protect Southern Resident orcas, other endangered animals, and our planet!

Dear Sun, **I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.**

**I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.**

But there’s also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn’t what it used to be.

I’ve been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That’s the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That’s 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.
**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. **Joining the Sun costs as little as $0.01 per day.** I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

## Secret Service Names Zero Cocaine Suspects
The Secret Service conducted an investigation into the bag of cocaine discovered in the White House last week, and it was able to name [precisely zero](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNkeHz5h48NAlW7p2RMa-g6scjMAJ6t9X6dzx6S1P7-s-3oNkWefP8CBfuYwhVnnRCIPqjNI46jZ5JtKELfnOXh0imqtuFw_MjA4AwbGNNiBwYjMw9hEi49SK16ARhs6A6zWai3WdiVr3jjs3QQyNAUpSy375LrLWhTj_lBftl1gebfZLrdvR4Eejb42-hW2l83irN-xVYqZG32KJQVZS5yKV1FKeB6lJEq0q7c_5UCcdVZ2yzorsxN0QzMQ0JNNDCNYC9CFZJqJo292n7ZSc5bBDY2B-BMl_KfX_M78BAAD__zMjZOQ) persons of interest.

The bag was subjected to an FBI crime analysis, but no evidence could be found linking the cocaine to anyone inside the White House on July 2nd.

House Speaker Kevin McCarthy [sounded off](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFy6yAQQNGvkTo0aEGSKShe486vTanBsJjNgPCIjRX9fcapU5_mzv24rTdHmbbHf1fQcqyr80wvXOUiRi1ArdAHGxEBVY92nC9GKaUv0Cfro5uDnz1oPwa5KDNPYCJGDCreJ5x7siBByWXU0kyg9DCbUXuAycTR3KV3nZYYiOs-fFbaOGHMZ33hPvha-mwT87N16l8H1w6ux3EMsX5veLS3d3AtGMi9JRGjSPWrofDVO9pQlLMx7qdoqR5N3CngJh7ITbQnenJZ8I6OC24sivdu53T2uw3Pg3KmNi-dlo_iKP-m8N9nfgIAAP__igloog) on what he perceives to be special treatment for the Biden family, illustrated by the cocaine investigation--or lack thereof. "_When it comes to the Biden family, they are treated different than every other American family_ ," McCarthy said.

The bag of cocaine wasn't the only illicit substance found in the Biden White House; [marijuana](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1yqzAQQOGngW4ZseLHKihuQ-fbpmSEtJj1yJJHWiB5-0xSpz7Nme_jvtwtB46P__ZFk2xpsU74pEWN0HaAesHaTxsRkq5paoeb0Vp3N6z3STmnWjOiGsyoyaIfvSfvjLcb9Tff1zyhQq3GtlOmR901g2k7h9ibrTWrcrbqFHmWlJtn4ig7beErnZQbl151mHaRd6n0vwrnCufrupotfUa6yk-vcH6nwMKuVDjHJPA8ioBLznIkKOQyCRTKJzuCTCfZUMDGJDtlWG2M5KEcaxEbHcGWjuhhZU-xwLWzEOzpKFTnyb8vDoHLMFaderwsh98_-ZvrOwAA__96snB4) has been found twice in 2020.
## Special Counsel Rips Trump Trial Date
Jack Smith, Special Counsel in the classified documents case against Donald Trump, [attacked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1hwwSYePHTxlq4dLX4uyY2wQYbEyttX6dz5-450dH6u69VSov32bTecW8yr9Y1euArDpeagVujCHBEBVYezHC-TUkpfoLvPLiqj3ejADSJIc0EHatAmSD15LZ3paAYBShipxTSA0v04Se0BhinKyQlvmRYYqOWjf2Ta2x1jeucXHr3PW5fme2ulMvXFYGGwnOfZ787veNbPzmApOVEjXxksj2dt5JEHLPZoG-6NwVILerKJ-_zcKyaeS8kVK2_HcyscY8xH4wGTfXOfbK0UCQMP2X8uHxAEaH743U5aGtkdcygnpUR1NEyL22Yp_am2_8v9BgAA__9C5HHi) the former President's lawyers' suggestion that the trial wait till after the 2024 election.

Trump's lawyers [have called](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskMFuhCAURb8Gdxh4MCILFk0ad9N016VBeCoNigWciX_fTNdd33uSk_N1H-82xLAvH3ZDU-c0WlfDA0emKJcUxAiNNzMioGjQ8K7XQgjZQ7Ma5eabnrT1CialeuxY7zrPmeu515yJJhhgIJjikukbCNl2mksHcNMz1xNzlkiGPtSU2-8U9rriHK_0wNy6tDXRrLUehYg3AgOBwU5ux2dpl_SaCQyfKYYaXCEwlANdsJG6dO4FI7V5ObHQms_tKDTjz4ml0oj7UteL1vz6eoz2erE15YuIIXgi3jnjILjq-iYbfzxDjKF0iki2bDbEP6_6f6bfAAAA__98s2mq) the Counsel's suggested start date in December of '23 "_unreasonable, telling, and ... result in a miscarriage of justice,_ " due to its proximity to the Presidential election, but Smith fired back:

"_There is no basis in law or fact for proceeding in such an indeterminate and open-ended fashion, and the Defendants provide none_."

U.S. District Court Judge Aileen Cannon has scheduled a conference between the two parties.
## TSA Agents Stole $1,000 Per Day
Three airport TSA agents have been [stealing regularly](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuxCAQRL8Gd1h44YwpXKShu7QprQ0sPiJsTkDO8t9HvjrdFKM3o_d1X-4YU9zXT9xobiEv6Fp80SI0HxQHuUDn50AEJDuah3EyUko1QfeY1WTQTWHSCAFg1KMHo70yzikp3Xjr4gwCpNCDEuYGUvWjGZQDuJkwmG_hkClBPrZc-p8c9_agkM78otK7vHVpfrT2rEx-MLAM7HEc_W_Flj2eV4GBrS2Xk4FtBV-UGFiMJcWd-E5HZWCveQZWaAZ2uFKryHMI0VGpHEuh2shzTIlW8unkteVEPJS88SfWSvtK5QJpoQYx6km8UV2Z_fOIKcU6aqbEumFM78_tf4V_AQAA__9RHHCr) from travelers.

The trio worked at Miami International Airport, and they had a system worked out that garnered around $1,000 dollars per day.

The scheme can be observed in the surveillance footage: one or two of the thieves would distract a passenger while another grabbed cash from a wallet.

All three [have been charged](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFzhCAUhH8Ndjj4wPMoKNLYXdqUDsLDexkUB7gz_vuMqVPu7Bb7fV-P6WEp0rZ82hVNDWmyrtIbJzHwTnGQEzTeBERA2aDpbnctpVR3aJ5mRtW5IJ2-a-x7oVGJ4PUAXkltJcwNGRAgxdApoXuQqr3pTjmAXodOz8JZpgR6qim334m2-sQQz_TG3Lq0NtE8a90Lkx8MRgbjcRxtSD8bHuXqGYyvwmBcya7Ea7E8hUAOc-Hzq1T03MaIC_p48lLRXpA8xPMa-Fe-kqW8p1x5cRlxo20pfE-RHDbZ-P2gGKncBqbEslqKf6fq_45-AwAA__8ZOWvP) with committing organized scheme to defraud.

# _Join Us Next Month_
---
It's that time of the year again — the time to celebrate our party's proud history, our incredible grassroots volunteers and supporters, and to prepare for the fights ahead in November. Earlier this week, we announced that our 2023 State Dinner will take place on Thursday, August 10, 2023, at the JW Marriott Indianapolis and be keynoted by Congressman and Republican U.S. Senate candidate Jim Banks. Congressman Banks is unabashedly a proud Hoosier conservative who has fought for our shared Republican values both in the halls of the statehouse and the halls of Congress. We're excited to have him join us as we already begin to look ahead to next year. The night will also feature a special presentation of the graduating 2023 cohort of the Indiana Republican Diversity Leadership Series, our nationally-recognized seminar and leadership training program helping minority Republicans across the state step into party and civic leadership roles. This will be our third graduating class, and we're thrilled to have Bowie, Maryland, Mayor Pro Tem and City Councilwoman Roxy Ndebumadu joining us to provide remarks and present the cohort with their certificates. This will be an event you won't want to miss. So click [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/82cbd09c0dc3c677c3d6b838967d376c/40313) to RSVP, and we'll see you in August! Sincerely,

# _Another Investment in Broadband_
---
| |
---
_**Governor Eric Holcomb** stands with newly-appointed Tax Court Judge**Justin McAdam** and his family. **Gov. Holcomb** appointed **McAdam** to the position earlier this week._**
---
This week, **Governor Eric Holcomb** announced that the fourth and final round of the state's Next Level Connections Broadband Grant program funding is open, offering $80 million in grants to providers and utilities in order to deliver high-speed internet across the state.

As a part of **Governor Holcomb’s** $1 billion Next Level Connections initiative launched in 2018, the state has awarded more than $249 million to 187 broadband projects, bringing internet to more than 69,154 Hoosiers in 81 counties. And when accounting for local matching funds, that total amounts to more than $547 million invested in this critical infrastructure.

**What they're saying:** “As a state, since 2018 we have made unprecedented investments in connecting Indiana residents to their neighbors, schools, and the rest of the world like never before in our history.” said **Gov. Holcomb**.

# _Meet Natalie Rascher — Evansville's Next Mayor_
---
---
We've long talked about our deep bench of talent across the state. And in this year's municipal elections, it's certainly showing. **The candidate: Natalie Rascher **is an Evansville native with robust experience in the business sector and a strong commitment to her community. Her agenda — the _Rascher Playbook for Evansville_ — highlights five specific areas her administration will focus on to create an even better Evansville for the next generation.

On or before November 7, vote **Natalie Rascher** mayor of Evansville!

# _Axios: Old Yeller: Biden's Private Fury_
---
**Joe Biden** (Jan. 20, 2021): "I am not joking when I say this, if you are ever working with me and I hear you treat another colleague with disrespect, talk down to someone, I promise you I will fire you on the spot. On the spot. No ifs, ands or buts." In 2024, we can fire **Joe Biden**. From _[Axios](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/1a99721e8a1dcd13c3d6b838967d376c/40313):_ "In public, **President Biden** likes to whisper to make a point. "In private, he's prone to yelling. Behind closed doors, Biden has such a quick-trigger temper that some aides try to avoid meeting alone with him. Some take a colleague, almost as a shield against a solo blast." "The president's admonitions include: 'God dammit, how the f**k don't you know this?!,' 'Don't f**king bullsh*t me!' and 'Get the f**k out of here!' — according to current and former Biden aides who have witnessed and been on the receiving end of such outbursts." _[Story continues.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/10fbaad23773ad99c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_

# _Applications for Indiana Federation of Republican Women (IFRW) Executive Committee Being Accepted_
---
Indiana Federation of Republican Women (IFRW) members interested in serving as an officer on the IFRW Executive Committee can now apply to be considered for slating.
**How to apply:** Those interested may request information and an application by contacting Beth Boyce, Nominating Committee Chair, at [bethboyce@hotmail.com](mailto:bethboyce@hotmail.com "mailto:bethboyce@hotmail.com") or 317-445-1373.
**The process:** The Nominating Committee will review applications for president, first vice president, second vice president, secretary, and treasurer. The slate will be announced prior to the IFRW Biennial Convention and presented for a vote at the [convention](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/11128e5be6341c2bc3d6b838967d376c/40313) on Saturday, August 19, 2023.
* Those women elected as officers will serve a two-year term commencing on October 2, 2023.
* Completed applications must be submitted no later than 5 p.m. EST on Friday, July 21, 2023.

# _HEA 1008 Will Protect Pension Investments_
---
During the 2023 session, the legislature passed, and Governor Holcomb signed,** ** HEA 1008, a bill to protect and maximize pension investments. ** ****The details:** The bill protects Hoosier pensions and public retirement funds, ensuring the focus of investments are exclusively on maximizing returns and not favor subjective environmental, social and governance factors.
* "Indiana’s pension funds should only be considering financial risks and maximizing returns, and should not focus on fair-weather politics and standards that seem to be constantly changing," stated **Rep. Ethan Manning** , author of the bill.

---

# _"Bidenomics" Has Hollowed Out the Middle Class_
---
From _[FactCheckBiden.com](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/ce6eb9616202ab14c3d6b838967d376c/40313)_ : In his newest absurd claim, Biden now wants [credit](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/360af529006f0c0ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) for wage gains that happened before he became president. The reality is "Bidenomics" is [hollowing out the middle class](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/5717ed714f2dc6f7c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and forcing Americans to accept lower real wages. Biden’s economic fantasy couldn’t be further from the truth Americans are facing. **Zoom in:** Under Joe’s Bidenomics, persistent inflation has eaten away at wage gains, and more and more Americans have struggled financially.
* Bidenflation outpaced wages for a majority of Biden’s presidency – real average hourly earnings were negative for [25 months](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/8190e4457c82dc67c3d6b838967d376c/40313) and real average weekly earnings were negative for [26 months](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/5a916d3f891ce4d4c3d6b838967d376c/40313).
* Since [February 2021](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/b7b4c4f351149c82c3d6b838967d376c/40313), when inflation-adjusted average hourly wages - the Bureau of Labor Statistics adjusts to 1982-1984 dollars - sat at $11.39, real hourly wages have decreased by [3 percent](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/12c9baa49bc3c56f/2144f8e1b413eb84c3d6b838967d376c/40313).

**What is true?** Bidenomics is nothing more than lower wages and higher costs.

I was proud to introduce the "Think DIFFERENTLY About Education Act".

Too often, working with school administrators to get your child the resources they need can be a daunting and confusing experience. This bipartisan bill helps parents of children with disabilities advocate for the resources their child needs to succeed in school.

\- ["Molinaro introduces federal Think DIFFERENTLY About Education Act"](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=d29a6f1bc0&e=a39a20e5dd)
---

---
I recently held a roundtable discussion in Binghamton on the need to expand mental health and addiction treatment services in Upstate New York.

Right now our community simply does not have enough resources or personnel to address the growing demand for these services. That needs to change.

This is an issue that can transcend politics and I'm proud to continue to lead on it.

\- ["Rep. Molinaro holds roundtable on mental health & substance abuse issue"](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=7513a3b4c8&e=a39a20e5dd)
---
|
---
| |
---
There has been numerous studies on the significant learning setbacks experienced by school-aged children during the pandemic, and students with disabilities were particularly affected, with limited access to essential therapies, altered Individualized Education Program goals, and extensive time away from the classroom.

It is essential that we understand the unique needs of these students so educators, parents, and lawmakers can develop informed solutions and never let this happen again.

\- ["Congressman introduces bill to address learning setbacks"](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=d6e4809d24&e=a39a20e5dd)

**The bad news** : We are falling short of our World Orca Day goal. **The good news** : There are still 12 hours left to help us reach our goal and have double the impact! We thought donations would skyrocket when we announced our World Orca Day matching gift opportunity because endangered Southern Resident orcas desperately need our help more than ever. name: Captain Sam Brown
subject: You deserve better
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sam Brown
body:
I’m running for the U.S. Senate to continue a lifetime of service

| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z9t5ridb8mmahib9b15devbhugdful74578e799g_rp22sh2s8i66o74spim0o30c3h2bs)
---
| | I shouldn’t be alive, Friend. When I was serving in Afghanistan, a roadside bomb blew up under the gas tank of my vehicle. I burned alive for what felt like an eternity as I came to terms with my mortality.
---
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zb8kobbc1b2el4u3d8c56hb3ogp8fmbta2m53fuo_rp22sh2s8i66o74spim0o30c3h2bs)
---
I thought it would be the end of me, but by the grace of God, I survived. I got a second chance at life, and there’s no way I’m going to waste it by only looking out for myself. [**That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Nevada**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zs75jssd4qa8emte492aqeh9ll2gickin5psmkv0_rp22sh2s8i66o74spim0o30c3h2bs) — not because it’s easy. But because the reason I’m still alive today _is to serve_. Our nation is in crisis and our so-called “leaders” have gone AWOL. With an economy in shambles, unprecedented threats from our adversaries, a wide open border, and D.C. politicians like NV Sen. Jacky Rosen failing to tackle our challenges head on, our nation is on a collision course with total disaster. **Too often, politicians only work to serve themselves while forgetting about the people they swore to serve. They see a challenge and they run the other way.** Well, Friend, I’ve survived my fair share of challenges, and I’m willing to take this one head on — because even though I’m no longer on active duty, I haven’t given up on my commitment to service. What we've done the last week.

| **Weekly Newsletter**
---
| | Derek,

I hope this message finds you well! At the beginning of the week, I put out a new video about Granite Solutions' goals and my mission for the 2024 elections. It's pretty simple - we need to expand educational freedom, enshrine parental rights into law, and lower taxes for all Granite Staters. If you haven't yet, [please watch and share my video here.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fdonate/1/0100018954467e31-b08cd152-9c0e-431a-9958-ae788b6d956b-000000/4Cj-ICygdlfr9DaQauMo3RjgbCU=330)

**Battling Misinformation**

This week, President Biden tweeted about the current state of the economy, offering a rosy view that unfortunately falls short of the full reality. Costs are up by 16.6% since his inauguration, and it's clear that his economic policies are impacting our everyday lives. From groceries and gas to restaurant meals and other goods, Granite Staters are feeling the pinch. We're working hard to correct this misinformation and shed light on the real impact of these policies. [Read my statement here.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fpresident_biden_is_misleading_the_public_on_inflation/1/0100018954467e31-b08cd152-9c0e-431a-9958-ae788b6d956b-000000/nlanVC14AM5Mil5t9-MtAi_9p-E=330)

**Holding The Democrats Accountable**

This week, Mayor Joyce Craig launched her campaign for Governor in a private event held at the Rex Theater, a city asset redeveloped under her watch. We are committed to transparency, accountability, and the proper use of city resources. To that end, we're seeking clarification on the use of city assets for personal political gain. [Read my statement on Joyce Craig announcing here](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fjoyce_craig_wants_to_be_governor_imagine_that/1/0100018954467e31-b08cd152-9c0e-431a-9958-ae788b6d956b-000000/ed17NVtHgQEpk5kmWmt3Y7FYZdQ=330) and [my follow-up statement about her potentially misusing taxpayer funds for her announcement and campaign.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fdid_manchester_taxpayers_subsidize_joyce_craig_s_campaign_announcement/1/0100018954467e31-b08cd152-9c0e-431a-9958-ae788b6d956b-000000/c3Z7wxZM3qTQWWDmL4iWrUPEoDo=330)

**Get Involved****
**
Remember, there are numerous ways to get involved with Granite Solutions. Whether it's knocking on doors, making phone calls, or becoming a Town/Ward Captain, we need you on our team. To find out more, visit our website at[www.GraniteSolutions.org/volunteer](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fvolunteer/1/0100018954467e31-b08cd152-9c0e-431a-9958-ae788b6d956b-000000/W8XTQW40zmsw7KhKYBRu8zUm0vo=330).

As always, I'm humbled by your support and commitment to our shared values. Together, we are making a difference for New Hampshire. Let's keep the momentum going!

Best,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Chairman, Granite Solutions

body:
Next week, Israeli President Isaac Herzog is visiting the U.S. and will give a speech to a joint session of Congress — and there's no way in hell I will attend it.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=349%2E791427%2E5FtfJG)

Friends -
Next week, Israeli President Isaac Herzog is visiting the U.S. and will give a speech to a joint session of Congress — and there's no way in hell I will attend it.
I refuse to go and listen to a speech from a president whose country has banned me, and denied my friend and colleague Rashida Tlaib the ability to visit her grandmother in Palestine.
I will be perfectly clear: the U.S. should not be inviting the president of a country whose government — under its most right-wing leadership in history — has barred the first two Muslim women elected to Congress from traveling there.
While executive power in Israel is vested in the Prime Minister and his cabinet, the president as head of state has traditionally served as a “faithful policy ambassador” for the government in charge.
President Herzog's address comes at a time when that government is openly promising to "crush" Palestinian hopes of statehood, essentially putting a nail in the coffin of peace and a two-state solution.
It comes at a time when that government's extreme right-wing cabinet members directly attack our president.
It comes at a time when that government is pushing through a judicial coup to centralize power and dismantle checks and balances.
And above all, it comes during the deadliest year for Palestinians in the West Bank in history, immediately following Israel's largest military operation there in decades — one which flattened entire city blocks and killed at least a dozen people.
Israel's increasing violations of international law and human rights are deeply concerning — especially as the U.S. provides Israel with billions of dollars in military aid each year to carry out those crimes.
Last month, I opposed the invitation for Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to address a joint session based on his government’s human rights record. And next week I will not attend a similar address from President Herzog.
There's no way in hell.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

* * *

body:
this is personal...

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T23af54c6-25aa-47a0-9b31-6e7bba0c5ea9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | I’m used to being written off, Peter. When I first ran for Congress in Wisconsin in 1997, no one thought I could win — especially when an extremely popular challenger jumped into the race. I remember huddling with one of my staffers at the time, and she said, “Well Tammy, maybe you want to rethink what you’re doing because it’s going to be tough.” I looked her right in the eye and asked, “Do you think I should wait my turn?” The next thing I said was this: I believe that women have to run — especially when it’s hard — and not wait our turn. We can’t wait until we get a tap on our shoulder or we’ll never get anywhere. I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team would make history. When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the chamber from our state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. In 2018, despite being a top target for national Republicans and enduring over a year of attacks, you stood with me again, and we won. Time and again, grassroots supporters like you have defied the odds. The battle to protect this seat in 2024 will be no different, and it will require all of us working together to overcome the millions of dollars right-wing mega-donors will spend to defeat us and hand the Senate majority over to Mitch McConnell. [Together, I know we can defy the odds once again. So Peter, I’m humbly asking: Will you help us protect this seat and the Senate majority with it by splitting a donation today between my campaign in Wisconsin and Blue Amp Action? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbdb30338-5d9f-4bf2-83d5-d8edd35b3b06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
Peter, let me explain: [**FIRST:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66472317/416490489/-1810142053?refcode=20230714_em_fr_b1_nraja_30_rs&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NGY2YWJjYy00ZTIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PUcar6BhcuXMUU4JEad2SgIlm6z7r9-os6S7exnpMQo=) House Republicans passed a bill to make massive cuts to Social Security, veterans’ benefits, education, and more. [**THEN:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66472318/416490490/-1810142053?refcode=20230714_em_fr_b1_nraja_30_rs&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NGY2YWJjYy00ZTIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PUcar6BhcuXMUU4JEad2SgIlm6z7r9-os6S7exnpMQo=) Kevin McCarthy raised $38 million in just three months to lock us out of power and push their far-right agenda for another two years. [**_NOW: I won’t lie to you: This is the kind of money that could buy McCarthy another two years in power. But hear me loud and clear: We’ve come too far and shattered too many expectations to let MAGA Republicans take a sledgehammer to all our progress now. I know this message is long, but I hope you'll take a moment to read it and be reminded of all the things we have been able to accomplish because of our victory in 2020. Then, I'll explain why your support matters so much — especially this early in a campaign. When Kamala and I were sworn in over two years ago, the economy was on its back. Schools and businesses were closed. People were hurting. And far too many were mourning the loss of a loved one to COVID-19.

Kamala and I agreed that we couldn't just rebuild the economy as it was before: we needed to build an economy from the bottom up and the middle out, not the top down. So we got right to work and passed the American Rescue Plan.

**Today, our economy has recovered faster and stronger than any other developed country in the world, we've created more jobs in two years than any president in a four-year term, and the unemployment rate is near record lows.**

And we didn't stop there: we kept working to make progress on the issues that matter.

We passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, kicking off a decade of rebuilding our country's roads, bridges, highways, ports, internet and railroads.

We passed the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly three decades.

We took on Big Pharma _and won_ , capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month for seniors — now, the biggest insulin manufacturers are lowering the cost for everyone.

We passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which is bringing down costs for working people and is the largest investment to combat climate change in U.S. history — because I believe building a clean energy future starts in America.

When I look back at all the things we've accomplished together, and all the work EMILYs List has done to elect Democratic pro-choice women, I feel proud — _and I'm reminded that there's so much more work for us to get done_. **If you're with Kamala and me in this fight, can I ask you to split a donation between our campaign and EMILYs List to help us build the foundation we'll need to win in 2024 and elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot?** | | | |

name: Troy E. Nehls
subject: I said it …
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nehls for Congress
body:
in my own words >>
| | | FBI Director Christopher Wray walks into Congress to give truthful ‘testimony’ ... that’s the punchline, and I’m not laughing. As you might know, I sit on the House Judiciary Committee, and in case you missed it, yesterday Director Wray had the audacity to ask for more money while simultaneously bold-faced lying to not just my face, but YOURS. Under the thumb of political hacks and hypocrites, the FBI has become a den of Washington wolves in sheepish black suits. It’s dirtier than a hog rolling in the mud before feeding time. The very first words out of my mouth to him were: “I am one of those sheriffs who will be very blunt with you today... I've looked at your testimony about numerous task forces, crimes against children and sexual human trafficking, MS-13 gang members, the poisoning and killing of the American people.” “... yet, in light of all that, it’s a reported fact that the FBI’s January 6th investigatory taskforce is the biggest in the agency’s existence to date. And there’s no mention of it in Director Wray’s 14-page testimony he provided to me and my colleagues. I asked him point blank, “WHY ... WHAT ARE YOU HIDING!” He stammered. I pressed on doing the People's work, asking him if he ever reassigned an FBI agent AWAY FROM investigating child sex trafficking cases, over to working on prosecuting Americans regarding January 6th. Again, he stammered, barely mustering “I don’t believe we have” ... LIES! I recounted to him the disturbing fact that last month, former FBI agent and whistleblower Steve Friend testified before the Weaponization Committee that IN FACT, FBI agents such as himself were forced away from investigating child sex trafficking in order to go after Americans associated with January 6th. We all know _why_ Director Wray doesn’t want to talk about this. Today’s FBI is MORE CONCERNED about searching for and arresting grandma and grandpa for entering the Capitol building on January 6th, rather than pursuing the sick individuals in our society who prey on our children! I WILL NOT sit idly by as Director Wray, the FBI and the rest of this God-forsaken swamp of a government want to put its head in the sand while innocent American lives are being wiped from existence. Enough is enough, and I can assure you: I will fight tooth and nail to prevent the flow of taxpayer money to political witch hunts. Period. Back to work, Troy [p.s. If you’d like to partner with my focused efforts to fire these federal frauds, please consider sending whatever financial support you can.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/5154cae44487eae0041ad8cde91a9694/35193/2a8b8f77a1f4218e/b7ba3e7d33f3b845c3d6b838967d376c/35193)

Wednesday, August 9th 5:30 pm Plumbers Union Hall 1519 Rollins Road, Burlingame Turning another year older is a good reminder of how much I love the job of representing you on the Board of Supervisors, and how much important work we still have to do together: Preparing for climate change by making investments to combat wildfires, flooding and sea level rise Improving health care, including greater access to mental health services and interventions Housing homeless individuals and families and providing intensive wraparound services such as job training I would still very much appreciate anything you can donate – the limit for this race is $2,000 per donor and every dollar helps get our message out! Hope to see you August 9th! Best regards, David Canepa, San Mateo County Supervisor, District 5 P.S. No matter the size of your contribution, donating today is the best birthday present you could give me – I would be so grateful if you could today. name: Katie Porter

body:
Each year, Congress and defense lobbyists play a game
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=26452%2E3422442%2ElHPRMH)
Each year, Congress and defense lobbyists play a game. **Defense lobbyists push for more spending than is necessary, and lawmakers–too afraid to look weak on defense–give in. It’s the taxpayers who lose.**
In yesterday’s Oversight Committee Hearing I turned that game around on Department of Defense (DOD) officials with a game called “JeoparDOD."
The answers to these questions are troubling. Here are a few of them:
* Which President allowed defense spending to grow by $100 billion in four years?
* _Who is Donald Trump_
* What program is $183 billion dollars over budget and ten years behind schedule?
* _What is the F-35 program_
* What has the Department of Defense failed to pass for years?
* _What is an audit_
* What percentage of DOD’s assets can it not account for?
* _What is 61%_

Look, Derek, if my kids couldn’t tell me where 61% of their allowance had gone, I wouldn’t give them more allowance. **Our military isn’t benefiting from this lack of financial oversight. Just one group is: Big Defense Contractors.**
Defense contractors and corporations' pockets are being padded thanks to their influence in politics. In fact, defense contractors spent $101 million on lobbying in just the first three quarters of 2022.
Lax Pentagon oversight coupled with a lack of accountability is wasteful, reckless, and unacceptable. **As a champion of oversight, I’m going to keep pushing against leaders in both parties to make sure taxpayer dollars aren’t handouts to private defense contractors.**
Katie Porter

Team, Pat Ryan here, and I have the tremendous honor of representing New York’s Hudson Valley in Congress. I was born and raised in Upstate New York and attended West Point, where I learned the values of duty, honor, and country. It was here that I first swore an oath to defend this country from all enemies — foreign and domestic. I take that oath as seriously now as I did nearly 20 years ago. **It’s the foundation of my values and ultimately why I chose to run for office.** Our country is facing new and increased threats to our security and our way of life. I fought to protect freedom abroad, now, I am fighting every day to protect it at home. For me, freedom isn’t a political bargaining chip or a cheap slogan. It’s the guiding principle of our nation and a set of ideals I risked my life to defend. Freedom is a woman’s right to control her own body without government interference. Freedom is a child’s right to go to school without the fear of being hit by a stray bullet. Freedom is every American’s right to breathe clean air and drink clean water. Freedom is a small town, main street business operating on the same level playing field as mega-corporations. Freedom is the right to marry who you love. Freedom is the security of a living wage, a paycheck that feeds your family, and the ability to join a union. **[I hope you’ll take a moment to read this note all the way through, but I have to ask: Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help us hold this toss-up seat in the future?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66477976/416510375/-138733819?amount=5&refcode=AU_PKR_FR_REA_GEN_INau_202307_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTU3ZmU2Yi01NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eSwc6EMeSrR02udtlImLXWcQGdREntPG030Kk8ZpNR0=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66477978/416510378/-138733819?refcode=AU_PKR_FR_REA_GEN_INau_202307_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTU3ZmU2Yi01NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eSwc6EMeSrR02udtlImLXWcQGdREntPG030Kk8ZpNR0=)

Last year, we proved pundits and pollsters wrong by winning a competitive special election in August that few thought a Democrat could win. Then, we proved them wrong again by winning a toss-up race in November. We did it because we pulled no punches, we met voters where they were, and we spoke plainly about the issues that matter. We spoke about freedom.
**Although we had some big wins in 2022, New York Democrats underperformed in several competitive races. There’s a lot we can do between now and the 2024 elections to make sure that doesn’t happen again.**
I’m going to keep up a strong messaging operation, reaching people across New York through ads, phone conversations, canvassing, events, and more. My campaign isn’t a short-term operation, because if we only show up for voters during election seasons, we’re letting them down. My team and I are going to work day and night to hold this seat and take back lost ground. We know that the path to flipping the House must include serious investment in New York. I am committed to being part of the solution.
Your support now will set us up for success for years to come. Building a sustainable, high-performing campaign in New York and beyond takes a lot of resources, and early investment is important. That’s why I’m asking:
**[Please, can I count on you to pitch and keep up the good fight for freedom, for New York, and for our country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66477980/416510380/-138733819?refcode=AU_PKR_FR_REA_GEN_INau_202307_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTU3ZmU2Yi01NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eSwc6EMeSrR02udtlImLXWcQGdREntPG030Kk8ZpNR0=)**
In my first months as a representative in Congress, I have kept my promise to fight for fundamental rights and freedoms – to give hardworking families and communities the economic relief we desperately need.
I’ll never back down in the face of a challenge. From protecting abortion access and holding utility companies accountable to safeguarding programs like Social Security and Medicare, I know there are steep challenges ahead. I will continue to be focused on our mission to fight inflation, curb rising gun violence, and improve the quality of life for our veterans. The stakes are simply too high right now. We must come together as patriots to govern.
**[I believe we are in an existential fight for our democracy and we need all hands on deck. Will you pitch in to help keep me fighting for a better future for all?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66477983/416510382/-138733819?refcode=AU_PKR_FR_REA_GEN_INau_202307_SR1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTU3ZmU2Yi01NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eSwc6EMeSrR02udtlImLXWcQGdREntPG030Kk8ZpNR0=)**

name: Alan Dershowitz
subject: The Sun's re-emergence is a gift...
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWpg7AtDNI

In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced
first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad
journalism....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWpg7AtDNI

FROM THE
DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ

Dear
friend,

In over
sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand
the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism - mostly
the latter - and just how important and rare it is to get things
right.

In
today's media landscape there are far too many publications that
get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political
implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New
York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over
politics and people over party.

Its
in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President
Trump serve as a case in point.

When I
defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an
avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to
fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's
deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky
and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the
Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be
first rate.

It will
be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can
be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that
its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments
in American journalism.

I've been
impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an
uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun's
success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of
truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage
you to join the Sun today.

Join the
Sun Now →

Every
person matters in this effort.

Don't
wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Alan
Dershowitz

Columnist, The New York Sun

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I didn’t know what to expect
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I could have never imagined our work would transform into a national movement for change. But we’re not finished yet.
#

Friends -
When I first started my work fighting to make our communities safer from gun violence, one of my biggest fears was that we wouldn’t be able to build the kind of grassroots organization necessary to challenge the gun lobby.
But more than that, I was worried that anything short of unquestionable success would be taken as a signal that there was no real public support for our work.
Almost ten years later, I could have never imagined our work would transform into a national movement for change.
But I still have worries. I worry about the ability to defend our narrow gun safety majority in the U.S. Senate, and what that means for our ability to pass more transformative federal legislation like the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act._
I also worry about keeping up our fundraising momentum, especially in these slow summer months. Our July mid-month fundraising drive comes to a close tomorrow at midnight, and as of now, we’re pacing behind where we need to be.
[**That’s why I’m respectfully asking: Can I count on you to step up and contribute $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july23.pfB_59&refcode=em230714-1-15&t=1&akid=6136%2E3935704%2EbgNDWW)

I am disappointed and frustrated at last week’s SCOTUS decision. But I am undeterred in my efforts to continue standing up for the working class.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66483785/416521797/919917611?refcode=BLU-SAN-20230714-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OGNkZTk1Yi01YjIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6TdqPsw5PW7W_eTox9fJ5BkTXnYc_dirTm8aaiMO92w=)

| Peter,

Last month, the Supreme Court voted to end affirmative action, effectively dismantling efforts to ensure higher education is accessible to all, regardless of race, ethnicity, or zip code.

My career fighting for working-class families – first as a labor rights attorney and now as a member of Congress – began with my parents. Despite not having graduated from college themselves, they worked hard to put all six of my siblings and me through college. Thanks to my parents’ sacrifices and years of efforts to break barriers to higher ed, I became a first-generation college graduate.

Diversity is one of our nation’s greatest strengths. Taking affirmative action off the table will strip the next generations – especially Black, Latino, and students of color across the country who are historically disadvantaged – of equal opportunity to quality education.

I am disappointed and frustrated at last week’s SCOTUS decision. But I am undeterred in my efforts to continue standing up for the working class.

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)
---|---|---

| | | **Friend, this is urgent.**
---
**Only 75 Southern Resident orcas are left alive, and the next generation is at extreme risk before even being born. ** **When Tahlequah tragically lost her calf, she carried its body across the ocean for 17 grief-stricken days.** The baby died just 30 minutes after birth, but poor Tahlequah couldn’t let go and refused to let the body sink. If we don't act now, this heartbreaking scene could play out over and over until this precious species is gone forever.
Due in large part to the devastating actions of greedy corporations, **orca mothers like Tahlequah are starving and struggling to give birth to healthy young whales. More than TWO-THIRDS of orca pregnancies in these unique pods end in miscarriages** – brought on by a dwindling food supply and constant survival stress. Without our urgent help, Southern Resident orcas could soon vanish from the face of the earth. So with time running out, **we’re setting an urgent goal to raise $90,000 this World Orca Day – and a generous group of donors has agreed to match all gifts up to that goal to help us get there – but only until midnight tonight.**
**[Please, we need your help to stop corporate greed from dooming our orcas to painful starvation and death: Will you donate $27 or more to Friends of the Earth now and have your membership gift MATCHED to fight for orcas, our oceans and our planet before it’s too late?](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1876795?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1876796?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
**We won't sugarcoat it: Orcas’ risk of EXTINCTION is growing by the day.** Not only are their primary prey – Chinook salmon – endangered, but **industrial expansion is making this situation even worse.**
Relentless noise from industrial shipping traffic interferes with orcas’ sonar abilities, making it exceedingly difficult to locate the already scarce food. **And if that wasn't already enough, ship noise can also drive away orcas’ food sources entirely.** But right now, the new Roberts Bank Terminal 2 is already close to construction, and**shipping traffic is set to _skyrocket_! **
Invaded by the commercial shipping industry, orcas face _another_ massive threat: Big Oil. A huge expansion of the Trans Mountain Pipeline is about to bring up to **700 TIMES more tar sands** oil through the waters these orcas call home.** All it will take to wipe out these vulnerable creatures is ONE single oil spill! **
**We can’t let fossil fuel greed become a death sentence for them and all their relatives. That's why we urgently need to step up our fight to protect our orcas, our oceans and our planet, and why we're counting on your support before World Orca Day ends and our rare match opportunity expires.**
**But right now, we’re falling short of our must-hit $90,000 goal, so please don’t wait:[Make your membership gift of $27 or more now and have it DOUBLED to help Friends of the Earth protect our orcas, our ocean ecosystems and the planet these precious species need to thrive. ](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1876795?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)

---
"Wes, you are not going anywhere until you give this place a try... too many people have sacrificed in order for you to be there."
Those were the words my mother spoke to me over the phone after I'd been busted trying to run away from military school. She'd heavily debated sending me. But at 13-years-old, I'd been cutting too many classes, been handcuffed in the back of a police car, and she knew this might be my last chance to escape being lost forever.
So, after some advice from family friends, she finally decided to send me to Valley Forge Military Academy.
I'm lucky. Thanks to my mother's and grandparents' love, the community that stepped up to support us, and mentors I met at Valley Forge and after, I changed course. I stayed at Valley Forge, joined up, and eventually became an Army captain and deployed to Afghanistan.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66487586/416533073/1636706682?refcode=fl_em_fr_20230714milschool_wm_180da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTVhNzRkOS02MDIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yI71G8gSHbX1CRYQ6vNPuJCZ-Naq6AVhnIeDf6CnRRc=)
---
I ran for governor because I know the difference that last chance made for me. After having the military motto of **"leave no one behind"** drilled into me, I couldn't stand on the sidelines when I realized people _were_ being left behind in my own country.
It became my slogan for my campaign for governor. And it's the promise I made to every Maryland resident when I took my oath of office. And it's one I have spent every day since working to fulfill as your governor.
**But just like my mom couldn't do it alone, just like no service member gets the mission done alone, neither can I.**
[**So I'm asking you, if you believe in a Maryland where no one is left behind, will you pitch in to keep our work going? I know from personal experience the difference it makes when everyone gives what they can.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66487587/416533074/1636706682?refcode=fl_em_fr_20230714milschool_wm_180da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTVhNzRkOS02MDIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yI71G8gSHbX1CRYQ6vNPuJCZ-Naq6AVhnIeDf6CnRRc=)
