Dear Friend,
I recently had an enlightening experience traveling with Dr. Bob Lorinser across Michigan's first district and felt compelled to share it with you.
Our journey showcased the tremendous impact Dr. Bob has made through his dedicated service as a rural medical professional and a mentor to many in the field.
Everywhere we went, we were greeted by individuals whose lives had been positively influenced by Dr. Bob - people he had personally treated or those cared for by doctors he had trained. It was an awe-inspiring reminder of the significant difference a dedicated individual can make.
But Dr. Bob is more than just a doctor. He is a passionate advocate for rural America, someone who has spent decades living, working, and championing causes in this region. He raised his family here. His work as a physician has made him a leader in rural America, especially in healthcare - precisely the kind of representation we need in Congress.
Having worked with the likes of former President Barack Obama, various state and congressional representatives, and numerous local officials, I can say with confidence that Dr. Bob Lorinser is a rare find.
His exceptional leadership skills, sound judgment, and impeccable integrity make him the kind of candidate we need to represent us.
Moreover, Dr. Bob is convinced that Democratic values mirror rural values [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] . He fondly recalls the time a decade ago when this district was a stronghold of the Democratic party, and he believes we can regain that status. Dr. Bob is confident that, with policies genuinely representing rural Michiganders and Democratic values, we can triumph.
Friend, to make this possible, we need your help. Campaigning is costly, and every dollar donated brings us closer to our goal. Your generous donation will go directly towards empowering Dr. Bob to continue his fight for our rural communities and Democratic values in Congress.
Please consider making a contribution to Dr. Bob's campaign today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] . Remember, every little bit helps, and together, we can make a real difference.
Thank you for your time, and for considering supporting Dr. Bob Lorinser's campaign. Together, we can build a brighter future for our district.
Best,
Kevin Numerick

Our journey showcased the tremendous impact Dr. Bob has made through his dedicated service as a rural medical professional and a mentor to many in the field. What we've been up to:
Friend, Team KP has been busy! We've been attending events, arranging interviews, and meeting people across the state – all to make sure people have heard about Keith and how he wants to be a strong advocate for our community in Washington!
Our plans moving forward:
We want to make sure that Hoosiers have a clear picture of who Keith is and what he stands for – being a strong voice for our people and protecting our freedoms.
To do that, our team is working hard to continue to meet residents, stay in touch via email and text, and order essential campaign materials like yard signs and mailers.

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Not only is Washington state gearing up for the August primary elections, Pramila is in Washington D.C. fighting for our values at the federal level to ensure that our progressive voices are heard.
#
Peter,
July is often a slow fundraising month for campaigns like ours. Families are on vacations, kids are out of school, and most people are far away from their emails and computers.
That means that we need to work extra hard to build up our grassroots support to continue powering our campaign and maintain our momentum. **To keep pace with our July plans, we've set a goal to raise $7,500 by midnight tomorrow to boost our resources.**
[**Can we count on you to support our grassroots movement by making a contribution of $3 or whatever you're able to contribute today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42704?refcode=em20230714-2703&t=1&akid=2703%2E420207%2EOhPR2R)
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42704?refcode=em20230714-2703&t=20&akid=2703%2E420207%2EOhPR2R)**
We need to be building support for our progressive values at every level possible, and that starts by building our power from the ground up. As a grassroots movement, we don't rely on massive corporate PACs or million dollar mega-donors to bankroll our campaigns because that kind of support comes at a cost.
I'm not willing to compromise on the key policies that our country deserves. We deserve a just economy, comprehensive and universal health care, honorable education systems, housing as a human right, and so much more.
Not only is Washington state gearing up for the August primary elections, but I'm keeping up the pressure in Washington D.C. to continue fighting for our values at the federal level to ensure that our progressive voices are heard.

Together,
Pramila

I thought it would be the end of me, but by the grace of God, I survived. I got a second chance at life, and there's no way I'm going to waste it by only looking out for myself. [**That 's why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Nevada**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=02831d24294b4af488943a44becafc50&_e=XCJjXvVOEVtJvMQFG0wE9NaMUds_i1Xpcnl1NBopwvY37kviXHSBdsUZuTQCOMjEbSTjIIXavtPweBaOwB_YGwnlWcYQ5m9lF_wEwCmZobbiNZxWDFRk4PTCb988HjxAiw8pt1IWN6mf3gyUZHRO4owyyjaD4-p1BN6khYrFU4ql3DlJftOTGlQRpLxKkqv7fvI6NrWcuClYFtq1_DBEN5I3gb6kuYeIF7u08LpepxZ2Vy9qBJFHiSTQXqtPnUjCLo7qvFQYxpix_rE-_vBkCMFAIJw6JucGZVyKV608v-BFxXm3Woni-krpPg7OhSkCP9I-D1WhwAcCesvimvIB6wg_dRqP1Vpij6Ef-FkqnCZtaSHpjHGVGB7sRbejS0OMPD28NI7c3sSDPIycawqqzl3GQXkJWl2ACXLZHUxCe_FU0--9x8F8Vi8MHlX-RVctligMKDf0Swle_7F6ZpeWAw%3D%3D) -- not because it's easy. But because the reason I'm still alive today _is to serve_. Our nation is in crisis and our so-called "leaders" have gone AWOL. With an economy in shambles, unprecedented threats from our adversaries, a wide open border, and D.C. politicians like NV Sen. Jacky Rosen failing to tackle our challenges head on, our nation is on a collision course with total disaster. **Too often, politicians only work to serve themselves while forgetting about the people they swore to serve. They see a challenge and they run the other way.** Well, Friend, I've survived my fair share of challenges, and I'm willing to take this one head on -- because even though I'm no longer on active duty, I haven't given up on my commitment to service. Our country, our state, and our people deserve a Senator who's proven that they'll put everything on the line for America, just as I have. That's why I want to deploy to Washington D.C. for a new mission with the same goal: [**Serving our great country.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=02831d24294b4af488943a44becafc50&_e=XCJjXvVOEVtJvMQFG0wE9NaMUds_i1Xpcnl1NBopwvY37kviXHSBdsUZuTQCOMjEbSTjIIXavtPweBaOwB_YGwnlWcYQ5m9lF_wEwCmZobbiNZxWDFRk4PTCb988HjxAiw8pt1IWN6mf3gyUZHRO4owyyjaD4-p1BN6khYrFU4ql3DlJftOTGlQRpLxKkqv7fvI6NrWcuClYFtq1_DBEN5I3gb6kuYeIF7u08LpepxZ2Vy9qBJFHiSTQXqtPnUjCLo7qvFQYxpix_rE-_vBkCMFAIJw6JucGZVyKV608v-BFxXm3Woni-krpPg7OhSkCOchGD5eNzbKnslyyFsXqq3PICXtroqfby9AKm2HNzrNze7s7fVNwElIcyMRIT5IthxmmUIchaCjfo8upV-EddfNhZ_BSnw9Ze71Zy1G3BzQ2g0p5173z9m51ARkoHJ9LggNjSCr1ZJY8KY9IR_HyZg%3D%3D) Friend, can I count on you to have my back on my next mission? [**Chip in ANY AMOUNT >>**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=02831d24294b4af488943a44becafc50&_e=XCJjXvVOEVtJvMQFG0wE9NaMUds_i1Xpcnl1NBopwvY37kviXHSBdsUZuTQCOMjEbSTjIIXavtPweBaOwB_YGwnlWcYQ5m9lF_wEwCmZobbiNZxWDFRk4PTCb988HjxAiw8pt1IWN6mf3gyUZHRO4owyyjaD4-p1BN6khYrFU4ql3DlJftOTGlQRpLxKkqv7fvI6NrWcuClYFtq1_DBEN5I3gb6kuYeIF7u08LpepxZ2Vy9qBJFHiSTQXqtPnUjCLo7qvFQYxpix_rE-_vBkCMFAIJw6JucGZVyKV608v-BFxXm3Woni-krpPg7OhSkC9zeDS4pZ4U3n7HE--vftZYyhOiCNbxJhTKgZWnNGDZX8XFWU2A4CxqY-fH559T8RmGDqWgrcNkIpVGCOqt1VR8NQhUmIIf26ymIIJVdq_VYR5gOAKZTVYNFz0J-hjgENqka7JXxWyaKXSxPymOQQIA%3D%3D) This is our country and our fight. body:
I’m so proud of how far we’ve come and I’m inspired by how much we still have to accomplish.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)
Hi,
We’ve officially closed the books on the first full fundraising quarter of our campaign! Now, I’m excited that I can finally share some inspiring numbers with you:
* **$600k** raised in the _first four months of our campaign_
* **$300k** raised in the _first quarter of our campaign_
* From nearly **2,000 individual donations**

Those aren’t small numbers — in fact they show just how strong our movement really is. [**Can you help add to this momentum by making a contribution of any amount today?**](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/127?t=2&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230714?amount=10&refcode=em20230714&refcode2=61_1163_wrjnw1&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)**
Beyond _showing_ our strength, hitting numbers like these actually makes us stronger. We have the resources to bring on staff who can work with me to make sure folks across CA-12 hear my call for progressive change. We have the ability to invest in mailers that tell people what I’m about and why this moment matters. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg.
There were those who might have seen our rejection of corporate PAC money and doubted us, even counted us out. But I know our community — and I know we can accomplish anything, together. And knowing that it was people, not PACs, that brought us here makes moments like this one even sweeter. Moments when we get to see that our campaign truly resonates with thousands of people from the East Bay and around the country.
**That’s real momentum.** And it means our message of making a government that works for the voiceless matters, and resonates.
I hope you can see it too, because I know that we’re on the precipice of creating real, tangible changes for single moms like me, for the disabled, for Black and brown folks in CA-12 and beyond.
I’ve been fighting for that type of change in California for decades, and I’m excited to take this work — and the voices, priorities, and aspirations of all our communities — to the halls of Congress.
You’ve already shown me that you have my back, and that’s why I know I can call on you again: [**Can you contribute right now to help us start off our next quarter strong and reach our July fundraising goal of $5,000?**](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/127?t=3&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1) _We can’t slow down now_ _— we don’t have time._
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230714?amount=10&refcode=em20230714&refcode2=61_1163_wrjnw1&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)**
Anything you can give makes a real difference as we make big investments for this summer and beyond. I hope you’ll be able to support our campaign once again in any way you can.
[](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/127?t=4&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)
Thank you,
Lateefah
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-wrapper?refcode=em20230714&t=5&refcode2=61_1163_wrjnw1&akid=61%2E1163%2Ewrjnw1)**

body:

Hi Peter, it’s Tiernan!
As the campaign manager for Bob’s re-election campaign, my job is to look at the big picture and set the strategy for our campaign.
One thing that has been clear to me from the jump is that we can’t afford to fall short of ANY of our fundraising goals. In a race this competitive, even a few slow days of fundraising could affect our ability to run a powerful campaign.
**[Our July 15 deadline is less than 48 hours away — Peter, will you make a contribution of any size today to help us reach our mid-month goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230714-1?refcode=em20230714-1&refcode2=303_552475_7-sWVN&akid=303%2E552475%2E7-sWVN)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230714-1?refcode=em20230714-1&refcode2=303_552475_7-sWVN&akid=303%2E552475%2E7-sWVN)**
Running a Senate campaign is expensive. Running a campaign in a state targeted by Mitch McConnell and national Republicans is _even more_ expensive.
But with your support, I know that we can have what we need to get ready for all the attacks that are coming our way.

Dear Friend,
---
Our revival in Vermont is STILL ON despite the terrible flooding the region has experienced, but we are pivoting. We don't have a venue, and we don't have all the specifics, but here's what we know: people are hurting--many are displaced, without power, etc.

We don't just want to bring worship, we want to bring food and water with us for our revival in Montpelier! Our prayer is that unbelievers will come for the food and water, stay for the worship and leave TRANSFORMED!! We need your help to do this. We need to raise $25,000 before this Sunday's revival!! If you can, please help us fund this relief and ministry opportunity: **[letusworship.us/vermontrelief](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=f1a0b6205b7545faa42c66c158ca3a90&_e=Bscgxv-5aVVTw8MIJHA39Kuj3Y57Hd414FsmCD4-t8yjdr5FN2Y0js0abvlV1l_WzsORh8FtA5NGHUAdM9KLmcYUWDRkl6sIpY4UjMbKt3S0tmjoqBWbDSLSjNq6h5aupgRjFfU_ouHxkHEfs091Nh4wXU6M4weKuIjp5Pqkp-0evTtghwBDYLU1FeasV5JeYA6dbzkIFOb2qudr_AtTLrjNEiY38heiqgHK1N2A4jm_5U9sqrahpjzxuhOUxO_C8oZNo6bEIH-62DvkWurnl2Gm9NDbzK24cIakQ4qhfd9gpCaf1GYwm8l__dxWQEzu)**.
Jesus met the tangible needs of people, fed the hungry, healed the sick, and even resupplied wine at a wedding! One of the things we pride ourselves on at Let Us Worship is our ability to **[rise up and help MEET THE NEEDS of hurting people.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=f1a0b6205b7545faa42c66c158ca3a90&_e=Bscgxv-5aVVTw8MIJHA39Kuj3Y57Hd414FsmCD4-t8yjdr5FN2Y0js0abvlV1l_WzsORh8FtA5NGHUAdM9KLmcYUWDRkl6sIpY4UjMbKt3S0tmjoqBWbDSLSjNq6h5aupgRjFfU_ouHxkHEfs091Nh4wXU6M4weKuIjp5Pqkp-1-HFD2t8EwOxE8pXxfOmo6e5WxcAZfGupQGOwQiujHMBnQYRrRREKM9crkAeVoGq9SS5_BbSFRUnhAMUhqy3jmObVKfiXsZbU1-0Nlw-vv8nTwbfoh_AcNYgbKPhsH-jG4oV5WnAuAju8p9InaLX83)** Area stores are without power, so we will be stopping in outside states before we get to Vermont. Please, help be the hands and feet of Jesus. Every dollar raised will go directly to relief efforts!

Here’s our Nashville mayoral race FAQ :
❔ When does early voting start?
TODAY July 14, 2023. Election day is August 3, 2023, with a runoff on September 14 if necessary.
❔ Who are the candidates?
I’m running in a crowded field of one dozen candidates, Peter. But I’m the only candidate in this race who has already been a mayor, and I’m running to put Nashvillians first and keep our community healthy, affordable, and safe.
❔ This all sounds really important – where can I go to vote?
Use this link to find your early voting location [https://www.nashville.gov/departments/elections/voters/find-early-voting-information] and make a plan to vote around your schedule!
❔ How can I check if I’m registered to vote?
Check your voter registration status here! [https://tnmap.tn.gov/voterlookup/]
❔ I received a mail-in ballot. What is the deadline to submit my absentee ballot?
You must mail your ballot in time for your county election commission to receive it no later than the close of polls on Election Day.
We know this is a lot of information, Peter, but it’s never been more important to Get Out The Vote.
Off-year elections typically result in lower voter turnout, which means that this race could come down to just a handful of votes.
Peter, it’s critical that we get this information to as many voters as possible between now and Election Day in less than three weeks. Will you chip in now to help us share this message with folks in every corner of Music City? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230714_em_fr_b1_HC_30_90_10_AllD]

With gratitude,
Heidi

Heidi Campbell is a Nashville native, Mom, former music industry executive and the first female mayor of the city of Oak Hill.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Growing up poor, this country took a chance on me. Now I am asking for you to take a chance on this campaign.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friends –
The things I want in life are not exotic. I think most people feel the same way.
I want loving relationships with my family. I want to help my constituents, and I want an America that lives up to its ideals.
Growing up poor, this country took a chance on me.
I took advantage of the things Democrats championed and the people of our country provided: Pell Grants and school lunch programs, to name just two.
Those helping hands gave me (and people like me) a debt of gratitude I worked to pay back through service — first in the Marines, and now in Congress.
The truth is, Senator Sinema has been an advocate for the rich and powerful in the Senate.
But those folks have enough advocates there.
It’s the people deciding between groceries and utilities who need help.
That’s why I am running.
But if we’re going to win this race, it is going to take a historic grassroots effort.
I couldn’t get to where I am in life without help. And I can’t win this race either. It’s going to take all of us to win. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to split $20 between Serve America and our Senate campaign before our fundraising deadline comes to a close? I would not be asking if it was not so terribly important. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]Thank you,
Ruben

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c81952f883894feb8f93f83ff1634457&_e=1o4eARusEHPJIzDQvhRy-lIz0nJywnwEq-Ol9DePQe-Eo4PfAgE7OFpCrvLPAqvyD0ysQTaBTl3w6-8E__9rTON93hzd5fvtIg0PzTpjVtb6Ifws2aiysxVWSfQ-Jn7xbQtmjOi2rVBFVColN_Pi1MgivGN7s_Hnn7USeuu-do9XF7UTlAo3eYbr370n_dzBXeRtwIPMriDMoJ9ew901OUUd32GSGZpBQQmMOItzsJr9mW-RClSBojQfnbkVV_A51sQ3eJsPz8Uq8DVDIwMXUaSsMmLtUbuXESVvlAKiol67OgiL_R53BmYqzwEmkSuPJsApCuTK8xxSBp3T4WqN4gzKh1bTHhiA-XHKTXTh8kVyEPbL0pOuNDA-qVLlqkggIkOt-16A0JkqR_IxhMcw41h9W6hd_2q6WBn8ibaN3f5zegS914NqBVsy-wGT2fdyeaPK8uLTkVHgCvTscSC8Tw%3D%3D)

I thought it would be the end of me, but by the grace of God, I survived. I got a second chance at life, and there's no way I'm going to waste it by only looking out for myself. [**That 's why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Nevada**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c81952f883894feb8f93f83ff1634457&_e=1o4eARusEHPJIzDQvhRy-lIz0nJywnwEq-Ol9DePQe-Eo4PfAgE7OFpCrvLPAqvyD0ysQTaBTl3w6-8E__9rTON93hzd5fvtIg0PzTpjVtb6Ifws2aiysxVWSfQ-Jn7xbQtmjOi2rVBFVColN_Pi1MgivGN7s_Hnn7USeuu-do9XF7UTlAo3eYbr370n_dzBXeRtwIPMriDMoJ9ew901OUUd32GSGZpBQQmMOItzsJr9mW-RClSBojQfnbkVV_A51sQ3eJsPz8Uq8DVDIwMXUaSsMmLtUbuXESVvlAKiol67OgiL_R53BmYqzwEmkSuP_OQU67R1yjv05c_3Ipnc0p-cCJd7uFZsS4xcP3ShGHbm80nk7u63GdGZbajpdfg0ZmN9nosbMDvRRw0xU-YeJCMjgbFgHxi74p3V1AOvtpz269VXiSIfo16EGk3Z8ODxnp39HZOZYe-lNGGvk978fg%3D%3D) -- not because it's easy. But because the reason I'm still alive today _is to serve_. Our nation is in crisis and our so-called "leaders" have gone AWOL. With an economy in shambles, unprecedented threats from our adversaries, a wide open border, and D.C. politicians like NV Sen. Jacky Rosen failing to tackle our challenges head on, our nation is on a collision course with total disaster. **Too often, politicians only work to serve themselves while forgetting about the people they swore to serve. They see a challenge and they run the other way.** Well, Friend, I've survived my fair share of challenges, and I'm willing to take this one head on -- because even though I'm no longer on active duty, I haven't given up on my commitment to service. Our country, our state, and our people deserve a Senator who's proven that they'll put everything on the line for America, just as I have. That's why I want to deploy to Washington D.C. for a new mission with the same goal: [**Serving our great country.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c81952f883894feb8f93f83ff1634457&_e=1o4eARusEHPJIzDQvhRy-lIz0nJywnwEq-Ol9DePQe-Eo4PfAgE7OFpCrvLPAqvyD0ysQTaBTl3w6-8E__9rTON93hzd5fvtIg0PzTpjVtb6Ifws2aiysxVWSfQ-Jn7xbQtmjOi2rVBFVColN_Pi1MgivGN7s_Hnn7USeuu-do9XF7UTlAo3eYbr370n_dzBXeRtwIPMriDMoJ9ew901OUUd32GSGZpBQQmMOItzsJr9mW-RClSBojQfnbkVV_A51sQ3eJsPz8Uq8DVDIwMXUaSsMmLtUbuXESVvlAKiol67OgiL_R53BmYqzwEmkSuPmvYuDLG3XvadWnIGOu1mxHa3FwZd8xY495hzJbAkY-lA9NCHpLsxrl1AYdKuU72ZvyQHPEYqeZQuZCKgmp4xMsy9gHwf7V7DptfXW1JcWzzB-0fJCcbmbI5HwLg77HJNRrW3Rojf3MRz8BDsZ8XwEg%3D%3D) Friend, can I count on you to have my back on my next mission? [**Chip in ANY AMOUNT >>**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c81952f883894feb8f93f83ff1634457&_e=1o4eARusEHPJIzDQvhRy-lIz0nJywnwEq-Ol9DePQe-Eo4PfAgE7OFpCrvLPAqvyD0ysQTaBTl3w6-8E__9rTON93hzd5fvtIg0PzTpjVtb6Ifws2aiysxVWSfQ-Jn7xbQtmjOi2rVBFVColN_Pi1MgivGN7s_Hnn7USeuu-do9XF7UTlAo3eYbr370n_dzBXeRtwIPMriDMoJ9ew901OUUd32GSGZpBQQmMOItzsJr9mW-RClSBojQfnbkVV_A51sQ3eJsPz8Uq8DVDIwMXUaSsMmLtUbuXESVvlAKiol67OgiL_R53BmYqzwEmkSuPN_uPcb1XIogkfJ-Ryw_WoCepxfYX7ElFBJbe399oetuC6JVkomekFELXDfb1kBjkbRgOPGOLlUGKjUKXfWnTU75cuode_uKxlUar74XmtJVd0LvhFDgDftiiYN1sPQyRdthfHxpU0VU3GwTrlcxCMA%3D%3D) This is our country and our fight. Peter,

During my time as a U.S. Navy SEAL one of my favorite assignments was Commanding Officer of BUDS. I was in charge of training prospective SEALs, putting the wanna-be frogmen through the toughest training on the planet, weeding them out during Hell Week, and pushing them to their mental and physical limits. **Most of them broke. The ones who Never Quit became SEALs.**

Let me tell you: _**Recruitment is everything. We landed a HUGE recruit for Montana.**_

Let me introduce you to U.S. Navy SEAL, Purple Heart recipient, successful businessman, wildland firefighter, husband, father, and a True America First Patriot - **Tim Sheehy.**

In 2015 I had the honor of pinning Tim's Bronze Star and Purple Heart and today I have the honor of endorsing him to be Montana's next US Senator.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=1ae25d28adf2441589bd038be1bdb112&_e=RhLgdCALqvclcgq3J9RNSeiP7DVnzBzCeilIjlZOo1CK9dwLBKrZ3cBfAMWjeQZI-ufQ89wQ6_MJ6p3rHyZxx49TkmDdqm7iJG-p0lmJJLDdW8kCrDjic9IJFhpYIGnAQfVo7nrN2hfkmlUbDyCqWsEptIgDU0Jbxm7WA1-Nb99FN4gkbpOSjljORZWvtVGCKLcWThD5nxJHxPLGXs6D8OZd-mnDU1QX_LcU5qSW4KlYW03D9kBzpjIlsrHL-1otXxkHmGGQvkV9gtZ19qNw2-4-r4Xq6M6n6lokhHyuMDs53gnd4WgIbt6k1ZUTX3y8vDfvCzqDU6GrZ--rhRj_CSM42A9w8lqJJYZTNStBA6q7l4mGQUH0MPqhznN21oMsLfr0hf-AB2bQQ3vkk_0drNMYe1PDl3QIF0Q7ZyDIOnY%3D)

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f0f0ee2f9c64d5a92b506abe6a5b6cd&_e=F90e2KDDMqECEaG-9uAWZPvizMCf3b3KJ9E2hNAstuLyhdK6km7rt517ekTcCaTYKKDQcU7zWUBxzcT7SRl3DhiUngMr89UwTdMoD14b1VSvVGEFjMNnuQVTyjx15hxqq1r5ULGTzFH9z6gpJrlV-UAW6uMQZJz0pNWwc-w9oeCs3fAUTK6Wc2cbieLDydwhJPMUdTDXVZr7GZc_LAMfNwVD1RBTx-Ns4nTPmzUVY5pbdIlw_TFnItGuyQTrkWM50fNnZE5ml2EF8428DaLQlxjUCdVK9_HpMf4BH26DuVyacC-xqCFBJARkv7qE_Dxz2s_eAdD-M2hpZeP-T_f1wNorzgHSgTquimwK0vquVEw%3D)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f0f0ee2f9c64d5a92b506abe6a5b6cd&_e=F90e2KDDMqECEaG-9uAWZPvizMCf3b3KJ9E2hNAstuLyhdK6km7rt517ekTcCaTYKKDQcU7zWUBxzcT7SRl3DhiUngMr89UwTdMoD14b1VSvVGEFjMNnuQVTyjx15hxqq1r5ULGTzFH9z6gpJrlV-UAW6uMQZJz0pNWwc-w9oeCs3fAUTK6Wc2cbieLDydwhXUiPMq7-dMgGi1oRHwZYp5q818868nArUjyTURq14YdQ50grT4w04_G0AC4qxN7WzKA6IXVtLsQiN5EpZ9-9m2CveCg87ynQTN3aNMpr_0ZppZT-zmeAlhPdA0pDrNG9qylKlozVrdRpAfR4ZqNYJB2fkUFOkVcATw8YIutMX30%3D)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f0f0ee2f9c64d5a92b506abe6a5b6cd&_e=F90e2KDDMqECEaG-9uAWZPvizMCf3b3KJ9E2hNAstuLyhdK6km7rt517ekTcCaTYKKDQcU7zWUBxzcT7SRl3DhiUngMr89UwTdMoD14b1VSvVGEFjMNnuQVTyjx15hxqq1r5ULGTzFH9z6gpJrlV-UAW6uMQZJz0pNWwc-w9oeCs3fAUTK6Wc2cbieLDydwhgrYSKSLH2RQMLzkRE-4Kogs_gNo0J3r8b76q_iPShidK16xBPIojOHD_dN1DvaGOxwECGgX5j78mE35CCKCYLc9OuJ4UkMEplBPYYw_Xw40WXoyQlGwsUSv3j946CMhHqA7g8KicYwvZpElYElQyyo4xU2rwp7fN2HwLD3IjarI%3D)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f0f0ee2f9c64d5a92b506abe6a5b6cd&_e=F90e2KDDMqECEaG-9uAWZPvizMCf3b3KJ9E2hNAstuLyhdK6km7rt517ekTcCaTYKKDQcU7zWUBxzcT7SRl3DhiUngMr89UwTdMoD14b1VSvVGEFjMNnuQVTyjx15hxqq1r5ULGTzFH9z6gpJrlV-UAW6uMQZJz0pNWwc-w9oeCs3fAUTK6Wc2cbieLDydwhRmd7CfAW_14TA8rleYgIbQ9S4m55J0gtbEJlFmX6CE-8ZnP424sQDvzCPKYyr6KFVSHI4xPPKsUBjfjkIGm2m9z7MKAOImjDWY5gU6SNKKOoglQGCPRz_rwH-RYu0jvw8KIKxhFFocjH0zK4RfPsE99f119-BuMwcAswOEKeyok%3D)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3f0f0ee2f9c64d5a92b506abe6a5b6cd&_e=F90e2KDDMqECEaG-9uAWZPvizMCf3b3KJ9E2hNAstuLyhdK6km7rt517ekTcCaTYKKDQcU7zWUBxzcT7SRl3DhiUngMr89UwTdMoD14b1VSvVGEFjMNnuQVTyjx15hxqq1r5ULGTzFH9z6gpJrlV-UAW6uMQZJz0pNWwc-w9oeCs3fAUTK6Wc2cbieLDydwh1FmhOmEwx4z1aD3TOkMtm3T5bgSVsz5JtXhR6Ei02n1eXiSAeja7eARTpBYW4shl0dWFyD7P9JBngXNQGYu0KmiJQIttzfVmBxEigfChZ5aTTqBp2VN0xfP03qNge56WSWA4ozq0LoE-zyLeJJHe_mmr547nKik8UYMRLZqZEdI%3D)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.

Dear Friend, I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances... ...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him. That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo. Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend. He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation. And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. But first, let me explain what happened... On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a violent criminal named Quadren Wilson. Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom. Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice. Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out. With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up. Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward. Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle. Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat. Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark. Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster. And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison. Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD). We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) offering to help Mark. This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help. They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge! But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it. This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question: Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family. # Eigel’s Donor Base Dominates Opponents, Over 41,000 Donations in Quarter Two
---
| The Eigel for Governor Exploratory Committee has demonstrated an unprecedented level of grassroots support, with Eigel For Missouri and BillPAC—Bill Eigel’s associated leadership political action committee— receiving 41,308 individual donations from more than 21,000 individual donors. The average donation to these committees was under $50.

“There is not another gubernatorial campaign that has built the network of committed donors that we have,” Eigel said. “For every special interest check or endorsement received by my opponents, a thousand people donated to my message and cause. Missourians are tired of sending uniparty, establishment Republicans to Jefferson City that hold Missouri back from the big conservative wins that all of us are desperate for.”

The total donations for the Eigel for Governor campaign amount to more than $800,000 for the second quarter, a record for the campaign so far. The combined total of these committees will report more than $1,000,000 cash on hand as the campaign heads into the late summer.

“The purpose of the exploratory phase of this campaign was to see if sufficient support existed for our message of a stronger Missouri,” stated Eigel. “The answer is a resounding yes – there is overwhelming support around Missouri for a proven conservative outsider. We are now preparing for a formal announcement and the end of the exploratory phase of the campaign. In 2024, there will be a reckoning for the Jefferson City swamp – their days of exchanging our rights for their gain are coming to an end.”

| | | Hundreds of critically important defense positions have been left unfilled because GOP Senator Tommy Tuberville of Alabama has put a "hold" on them -- a ridiculous Senate tradition that allows just one senator to block Senate action, _even if the other 99 disagree_. **Tuberville's action is being denounced by defense experts across the political spectrum as a dangerous threat to military readiness, and national security. ** [**Democrats have the power to stop him -- and they should us it ASAP. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T34d8a500-5529-47c1-bbc1-c08cc185dcdd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Tuberville is putting our nation at risk because he wants to score points with anti-abortion extremists, who object to the military covering travel expenses for service members who need to obtain the procedure. **[Senate Democrats can end this nonsense, and they should right now.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tce0f1a95-ebff-4ad3-af05-59c396fde594/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The "hold" is not in the Constitution, it's simply a Senate tradition -- an incredibly stupid one — that can be ended at any time by the majority. ** [**Add your name, and tell Senate Democrats to act NOW and end Tuberville's hold.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8df538e5-f969-4d25-95ca-6e41af797879/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496055/416562567/62647395?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjZlZDIwNmEtNzUyMi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FyJWvWY3n1rv0y15-o8Z1zqufrm2K9M-mf7fKuzt5e8=) Team,

SAG-AFTRA, the actors’ union, is officially on strike.

As of Thursday morning, SAG members have joined the Writers Guild of America on the picket line to fight for better working conditions and better pay.

**I want this community to know that I will always be a proud supporter of organized labor, and that I’m standing with you.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496057/416562568/-1241314520?refcode=em-7.14.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjZlZDIwNmEtNzUyMi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FyJWvWY3n1rv0y15-o8Z1zqufrm2K9M-mf7fKuzt5e8=)
It’s only fair that the folks who are an essential part of our creative economy should make a decent living to support themselves and their families.

It’s not unreasonable to want to be able to afford rent or a mortgage in one of the most expensive communities in the country. And it’s certainly not unreasonable to stand strong and fight for what you deserve -- even if it means going on strike.

I’ll stand in solidarity with the actors and writers for as long as it takes to get a fair deal.

Thank you,

Laura

---
Starving.
Grieving.
And just one oil spill away from EXTINCTION.
Endangered Southern Resident orcas are suffering, and Big Oil and shipping megaprojects are threatening the LAST 75 that are left on this planet. They are putting their profits over the survival of the only endangered species of killer whales in the United States. What’s worse is that **these orcas are starving and growing weaker by the day.** But two proposed megaprojects threaten to seal their DEATH SENTENCE. [_**Help protect these 75 remaining orcas and our planet by standing up to corporate greed and donate $27 or more today in honor of World Orca Day. When you do, your gift will be MATCHED, dollar for dollar, up to our $90,000 goal – but only until midnight TONIGHT.**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1877045?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
These Southern Resident orca pods suffered devastating blows with the deaths of Cappuccino, Marina, and Ripple. Cappuccino was a playful orca who greeted nearby boaters in his waters and was beloved by the community. Ripple’s birth was a marker of hope for the future of his family. And Marina was an iconic matriarch who cared for her grandchildren and taught them how to hunt and survive. Their deaths are an excruciating loss to the remaining orcas -- **and the grief is driving them further into starvation.**
Each Southern Resident orca is an integral member of their family. Every loss is felt by the entire pod. But Big Oil and the shipping industry are threatening them all with proposed megaprojects that would directly impact their habitats and drive them to EXTINCTION.
**Big Oil and the shipping industry are contributing to Southern Resident orcas starving to death. Help us fight for their protection and the ecosystems they rely on with your $27 donation before the clock strikes midnight!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1877041?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1877043?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1877044?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Southern Resident orca populations have been declining for the last 17 years. Key drivers to their extinction are tied to pollution and lack of food. Their main food source is Chinook salmon, which were once abundant in their ecosystems. But the salmon have declined so much in the last decade that they are now considered _endangered_ themselves. This is **leading Southern Resident orcas to starvation, stress, and miscarriages.**
The two proposed megaprojects would take things **from bad to worse.** The Roberts Bank T2 shipping terminal project would significantly increase cargo ship traffic and scare away Chinook salmon from orca habitats. The resulting noise from the massive cargo ships will also disrupt the orcas’ sonar hunting methods, disorienting and preventing them from finding the few salmon left in the region.
The expanded Trans Mountain Pipeline will also increase oil tanker traffic in Southern Resident critical habitat SEVEN-FOLD -- from one tanker a week to one per day! Worst of all, it will also be **pushing millions of gallons per day of toxic tar sands oil -- the dirtiest kind** – out in oil tankers through this already delicate orca habitat.
The endangered Southern Resident population is just one oil spill away from extinction. And we know that when you move oil, oil spills are practically a GUARANTEE. It’s only a matter of time, Friend. This is why we need to raise our voices and stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry, showing them that we will not allow them to put private profit over the lives of precious wildlife and the ecosystems that rely on them.
**Southern Resident orcas are one oil spill away from EXTINCTION. Fight the megaprojects that threaten their existence and our planet with your contribution of $27 or more now while you can make twice the impact.**

---
Orcas are crucial to a thriving ocean habitat, combating the worst effects of climate change, and benefit our own health. They release vital nutrients for phytoplankton, which then **provide half of the oxygen we breathe while absorbing hundreds of thousands of tons of carbon each year.** We depend on this flow of nutrients for healthy ecosystems and a functioning planet, which is why we must protect these orcas at all costs.
Each death in these pods reduces the chances that the remaining orcas survive. With Marina’s death, **her children are now three times more likely to die, while her grandchildren are SIX TIMES less likely to survive.** With these 75 precious lives at stake and at increased risk, we need to step up our fight to protect them.
Southern Resident orcas are in perilous danger. You and I may be some of the last people to share the planet with these magnificent creatures if these disastrous megaprojects are allowed to move forward. That is why we need you by our side,Friend.
Your membership gift of $27 or more to Friends of the Earth will allow us to fight these projects and the threats to our planet. Make your contribution now, while orcas still have a fighting chance!

Endangered Southern Resident orcas are suffering, and Big Oil and shipping megaprojects are threatening the LAST 75 that are left on this planet. They are putting their profits over the survival of the only endangered species of killer whales in the United States. What’s worse is that these orcas are starving and growing weaker by the day. But two proposed megaprojects threaten to seal their DEATH SENTENCE. == These Southern Resident orca pods suffered devastating blows with the deaths of Cappuccino, Marina, and Ripple. Cappuccino was a playful orca who greeted nearby boaters in his waters and was beloved by the community. Ripple’s birth was a marker of hope for the future of his family. And Marina was an iconic matriarch who cared for her grandchildren and taught them how to hunt and survive. Their deaths are an excruciating loss to the remaining orcas -- and the grief is driving them further into starvation. Each Southern Resident orca is an integral member of their family. Every loss is felt by the entire pod. But Big Oil and the shipping industry are threatening them all with proposed megaprojects that would directly impact their habitats and drive them to EXTINCTION. Big Oil and the shipping industry are contributing to Southern Resident orcas starving to death. Help us fight for their protection and the ecosystems they rely on with your $27 donation before the clock strikes midnight! If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: == == == == Southern Resident orca populations have been declining for the last 17 years. Key drivers to their extinction are tied to pollution and lack of food. Their main food source is Chinook salmon, which were once abundant in their ecosystems. But the salmon have declined so much in the last decade that they are now considered endangered themselves. This is leading Southern Resident orcas to starvation, stress, and miscarriages. The two proposed megaprojects would take things from bad to worse. The Roberts Bank T2 shipping terminal project would significantly increase cargo ship traffic and scare away Chinook salmon from orca habitats. The resulting noise from the massive cargo ships will also disrupt the orcas’ sonar hunting methods, disorienting and preventing them from finding the few salmon left in the region. The expanded Trans Mountain Pipeline will also increase oil tanker traffic in Southern Resident critical habitat SEVEN-FOLD -- from one tanker a week to one per day! Worst of all, it will also be pushing millions of gallons per day of toxic tar sands oil -- the dirtiest kind – out in oil tankers through this already delicate orca habitat. The endangered Southern Resident population is just one oil spill away from extinction. And we know that when you move oil, oil spills are practically a GUARANTEE. It’s only a matter of time, Friend. This is why we need to raise our voices and stand up to Big Oil and the shipping industry, showing them that we will not allow them to put private profit over the lives of precious wildlife and the ecosystems that rely on them. Southern Resident orcas are one oil spill away from EXTINCTION. Fight the megaprojects that threaten their existence and our planet with your contribution of $27 or more now while you can make twice the impact. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: == == == == Orcas are crucial to a thriving ocean habitat, combating the worst effects of climate change, and benefit our own health. They release vital nutrients for phytoplankton, which then provide half of the oxygen we breathe while absorbing hundreds of thousands of tons of carbon each year. We depend on this flow of nutrients for healthy ecosystems and a functioning planet, which is why we must protect these orcas at all costs. Each death in these pods reduces the chances that the remaining orcas survive. With Marina’s death, her children are now three times more likely to die, while her grandchildren are SIX TIMES less likely to survive. With these 75 precious lives at stake and at increased risk, we need to step up our fight to protect them. Southern Resident orcas are in perilous danger. You and I may be some of the last people to share the planet with these magnificent creatures if these disastrous megaprojects are allowed to move forward. That is why we need you by our side,Friend. Your membership gift of $27 or more to Friends of the Earth will allow us to fight these projects and the threats to our planet. Make your contribution now, while orcas still have a fighting chance! Cappuccino, Marina, and Ripple are dead. Don’t let their surviving family members meet the same fate. Make your contribution of $27 or more to Friends of the Earth before the clock strikes midnight and make twice the impact! Mitch Gore’s New Law Helping Crack Down on Illegal Machine Gun Switches_ Legislation this past session from Rep. Mitch Gore (Indianapolis) is already having a sizable impact on the [police’s ability](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496363/416563742/-2069487352?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) to target illegal machine gun switches and get them off the streets. Marion County is already seeing prosecutions involving these types of dangerous devices rise, as police work to keep our streets safe. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496364/416563743/1109473309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535)**[Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496365/416563744/1109473309?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) Hoosier Democrats will keep fighting for common sense gun safety legislation to protect children and families. We can and must elect more Democrats to repeal permitless carry, pass gun storage legislation, and tackle the scourge that gun violence is having on too many communities. ****_Curtis Hill Joins INGOP Clown Car Gubernatorial Primary_ We all unfortunately remember former Attorney General Curtis Hill and the shame and disgrace he brought to the state of Indiana. As AG, he pursued a [far-right agenda](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496366/416563745/-105105031?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) and was accused of sexual misconduct against a state legislator and three staff members at the Statehouse. Now, he’s [back and running](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496367/416563746/-1234377225?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) to be Indiana’s next governor. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496368/416563747/30121039?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535)**[Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496369/416563748/30121039?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) Just as we led the calls for his resignation five years ago, we’re calling on the Indiana Republican Party to join us in denouncing Hill’s candidacy. He is simply unfit to serve, and as governor would put our state in the spotlight for all the wrong reasons. He is against [women’s rights](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496370/416563749/-105105031?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535), voting rights, and [LGBTQ rights](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496371/416563750/-1234377225?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535). [We simply can’t afford four years of Curtis Hill.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66496372/416563751/-1138539356?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNjI2NDI0Yy03NzIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ah0Zfe9m-tACCdC4QWieHnJ_7KYa7C2gaNHVfaEvbKA=&emci=b9016a3c-6e22-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=3626424c-7722-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Mitch Gore’s New Law Helping Crack Down on Illegal Machine Gun Switches Legislation this past session from Rep. Mitch Gore (Indianapolis) is already having a sizable impact on the to target illegal machine gun switches and get them off the streets. Marion County is already seeing prosecutions involving these types of dangerous devices rise, as police work to keep our streets safe. Hoosier Democrats will keep fighting for common sense gun safety legislation to protect children and families. We can and must elect more Democrats to repeal permitless carry, pass gun storage legislation, and tackle the scourge that gun violence is having on too many communities. Curtis Hill Joins INGOP Clown Car Gubernatorial Primary We all unfortunately remember former Attorney General Curtis Hill and the shame and disgrace he brought to the state of Indiana. As AG, he pursued a and was accused of sexual misconduct against a state legislator and three staff members at the Statehouse. Now, he’s to be Indiana’s next governor. Just as we led the calls for his resignation five years ago, we’re calling on the Indiana Republican Party to join us in denouncing Hill’s candidacy. He is simply unfit to serve, and as governor would put our state in the spotlight for all the wrong reasons. He is against , voting rights, and . Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Throughout his time in the State Senate, Rodney Pol, Jr. (Chesterton) has proven to be a fighter for working families and to expand union membership in our state. We need to pass increased safety standards so that Hoosier workers do not lose their lives while feeding their families. Every job should be safe in our state. Democrats are committed to working to increase the living standards for Hoosier workers, and this starts with raising the minimum wage from the abysmal rate of $7.25/hour. Sen. Pol’s to raise the minimum wage to $13/hour would have lifted thousands of families in our state out of poverty and toward a better future. The last week of June wasn’t just the launch of our campaign; it also marked the final week of the Delaware General Assembly’s 2023 session. As I drove home from Dover late at night on June 30th, I reflected on all of the issues we made progress on this year and the work that remains when we return in January. This year, we passed important criminal justice reforms, raises for teachers, and a historic environmental justice package. **And I’m excited to say that almost all of the bills I introduced were passed and are heading to the Governor for his signature.** Here’s a quick wrap-up of some of my bills that we got over the finish line this session. We:
* **Established a state-funded program** to remediate lead-based paint in Delaware homes.
* **Combated corruption** by making it possible to investigate cover-ups by the powerful and well-resourced and providing our Department of Justice the tools necessary to go after abuse of power by public officials.
* **Closed the loophole** that allowed adults to enter schools with guns.
* **Guaranteed universal oral health screenings** for all kindergartners in public and charter schools.
* **Banned the “LGBTQ+ Panic Defense,”** a dangerous excuse for anti-LGBTQ violence.
* **Allowed qualified DREAMers and other undocumented residents the ability to secure professional licenses** like their peers who receive the exact same training.

**These are just some of my favorite bills that passed this year (most of which passed in the action of this final week)!** I'm so inspired to continue taking action and so grateful for my colleagues who partnered with me in this progress. Talk soon!

How would your life be different with citizenship? | | | Peter — **I was recently asked: How would your life be different with citizenship?** DACA changed my life, but I and hundreds of thousands of others like me still aren’t able to live our lives freely. I’d like to think that with citizenship, I would have been able to travel to places all over the world. It’s something I’ve always dreamt of doing, and something that I still have hope for if we can secure a pathway to citizenship. Looking back, having citizenship meant that I would’ve been able to say goodbye to my great grandmother in Mexico before she passed away. Every aspect of your life is impacted without citizenship, and I’m tired of all the instability. It’s time for permanent protections. With DACA recipients’ future in jeopardy and millions more undocumented people lacking any form of protections, we cannot wait to act. **But we need you in this fight, Peter. clean_body: How would your life be different with citizenship? | | | Peter — I was recently asked: How would your life be different with citizenship? DACA changed my life, but I and hundreds of thousands of others like me still aren’t able to live our lives freely. I’d like to think that with citizenship, I would have been able to travel to places all over the world. It’s something I’ve always dreamt of doing, and something that I still have hope for if we can secure a pathway to citizenship. Looking back, having citizenship meant that I would’ve been able to say goodbye to my great grandmother in Mexico before she passed away. Every aspect of your life is impacted without citizenship, and I’m tired of all the instability. It’s time for permanent protections. With DACA recipients’ future in jeopardy and millions more undocumented people lacking any form of protections, we cannot wait to act. But we need you in this fight, Peter. Here's the way I see it: The American people should have complete confidence that government officials are making decisions with only one factor in mind: the public interest. Not their own pocketbooks. Not their future job prospects in the private sector. Not the wishes of big donors and giant corporations. _The public interest_. So I’ve got a whole bunch of plans to root corruption out of Washington. Some are more specific, like my **Department of Defense Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act** , which would limit the influence of contractors on the military, constrain foreign influence on retired senior military officers, and require greater transparency from contractors in their interactions with the Pentagon. Or my **Judicial Ethics and Anti-Corruption Act** , which would strengthen ethical standards up and down our judiciary, impose an enforceable code of conduct on the Supreme Court, and ban federal judges from owning individual stock. Or my **Presidential Conflicts of Interest Act** , which would require the president and vice president to disclose and divest from any potential financial conflicts of interest. That’s a standard that President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris have already cleared — and that all their successors should be held to. Especially after we saw Donald Trump run the most corrupt administration in modern history. Or my **bipartisan legislation to reform the Federal Reserve** , which would bar big bank executives from serving on Reserve Bank boards of directors, subject directors to ethics and financial conflict of interest rules, and bring increased transparency and accountability to the Fed. And then I’ve got my big plan: the **Anti-Corruption and Public Integrity Act**. It’s the most sweeping set of reforms since Watergate. And it would fundamentally change the way Washington does business, including...
* Banning all individual stock ownership by members of Congress, Cabinet secretaries, senior congressional staff, federal judges, White House staff, and other senior agency officials while in office.
* Prohibiting all federal officials from holding or trading stock if its value might be influenced by their agency, department, or actions.
* Tightening conflict of interest and recusal requirements.
* Padlocking the revolving door between industry and government.
* Creating a new, independent anti-corruption agency dedicated to enforcing federal ethics laws.
* Expanding an independent and empowered Congressional ethics office.

**All of these plans have two things in common. They’re about putting our government on the side of the people — not the powerful special interests. And they’re only possible if we grow and strengthen our grassroots movement. That’s how we beat Big Money.** [**I’m running for re-election so we can root corruption out of Washington, rebuild our middle class, and strengthen our democracy. But I can’t do it alone. If it makes sense for you right now, will you pitch in $20 or any amount to help build our campaign from the ground up?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66512423/416597547/65265856?amount=20&refcode=EMZ15J_COR_E_20230714_V1S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODY2ZjI1My05YTIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lQ7obCCkm-WshQNMBCuIsceGDU2n6tsdSKwhm_KlEyA=) **Every donation is another signal that the American people are demanding real change and calling for a country that works for everyone, not just the rich and powerful.** I’m deeply grateful to fight by your side. And it would fundamentally change the way Washington does business, including... Banning all individual stock ownership by members of Congress, Cabinet secretaries, senior congressional staff, federal judges, White House staff, and other senior agency officials while in office. Prohibiting all federal officials from holding or trading stock if its value might be influenced by their agency, department, or actions. Tightening conflict of interest and recusal requirements. Padlocking the revolving door between industry and government. Creating a new, independent anti-corruption agency dedicated to enforcing federal ethics laws. Expanding an independent and empowered Congressional ethics office. All of these plans have two things in common. They’re about putting our government on the side of the people — not the powerful special interests. And they’re only possible if we grow and strengthen our grassroots movement. That’s how we beat Big Money. = Every donation is another signal that the American people are demanding real change and calling for a country that works for everyone, not just the rich and powerful. I’m deeply grateful to fight by your side. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate All content © 2023 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

name: Cornel West 24
subject: Help Cornel West Wage Peace!
body:
We can abolish poverty and end climate crisis by dismantling the war machine

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest24.org/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1a&n=1)
---
Peter - I hope this email finds you well and filled with the passion for peace and justice that powers our movement! As the NATO Summit wrapped up this week, Dr. Cornel West issued the kind of [powerful response](https://www.cornelwest24.org/press_release_071223?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=071423_fundraiser1a&n=2) we’ve come to expect from him: a call to end NATO, not expand it; to fund healthcare, not warfare; to invest in climate, not killing. Toward that end we urgently need a cease-fire and negotiations to halt the dire conflict in Ukraine. We must stop the expanding militarism that’s impoverishing and endangering us all. And we must redirect the vast resources being devoured by the war machine, to abolish poverty and solve the climate crisis instead! These are the real threats to the daily lives of billions of our brothers and sisters at home and abroad. Your support is vital to this cause. name: Andy Kim
subject: Let’s call this what is: voter suppression
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
Generations before us gave their lives so that today we would have the right to vote. There are people around the world fighting today for that same right. Voting is not something to take lightly.

That is why I am so disappointed in the actions taken by my Republican colleagues. For years, they have undermined confidence in our free and fair election process, including by perpetuating the "Big Lie" that the 2020 election was stolen. Now, they have introduced legislation that would make voting more difficult nationwide.

Instead of fostering an inclusive and participatory democracy, extremist Republicans are pushing to grant states more power to purge voters and to ban same-day voter registration.

Let's call this what it is: voter suppression.

If the extremist Republicans in Congress really cared about election integrity, they would denounce former President Trump and the bad actors who collaborated with him in his attempts to "find votes." However, they insist on advancing legislation that will just obstruct people's constitutional right to vote.

The right to vote is sacred. We must do everything in our power to remove barriers for people, not create more .

Together we will keep up the fight for our democracy and protect the right to vote!

Andy

If Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it's time we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the playbook for defeating the woke mob:
