| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Fellow American,

Since John McCain’s passing in 2018, Arizona has been in political turmoil. We’ve had two high-profile Senate elections in the past 4 years with** more than $340 MILLION **spent to persuade voters to cast their ballot for a particular candidate.

**As Sheriff of Arizona’s 3rd largest county,** I can only dream of what me and my team of deputies would be able to do with $340 million. I’ll tell you this: _**there would be no illegal immigrants on the loose in the entire county I’m responsible for protecting.**
_
Unfortunately, the days of raising - and spending - massive sums of money to win a Senate seat are here to stay. I knew that when I got into the race, but it doesn’t mean I like it. But in my mind’s eye, **the endless hours we’ll spend fundraising to build my profile are worth it**. The Democrats I’m running against are as progressive as they come and completely out of touch with the average American voter.

name: Larry Cohen, Our Revolution Board Chair
subject: I hope you’ll read Joseph’s message below
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY OUR REVOLUTION
body:
| Peter Willis,

As board chair, I don’t usually write our emails — but this is important. I want you to know that the work Joseph talks about in his message below is critical.

I’ve been organizing for more than 40 years. I am the past president of the Communications Workers of America and was a senior adviser to Bernie Sanders’s campaign for president. I’ve seen a lot and been through a lot of fights — enough to recognize the pivotal moment we find ourselves in today.

I believe in our team and our members here at Our Revolution, and I see the vital work they’re doing to mobilize a working-class coalition that will be a powerful force for change this year, in the 2024 elections, and beyond. **[When we get these shots, we’ve got to take them, and that’s why I hope you’ll invest in our team and our mission today. Stronger together and forward together.](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8874?t=8&akid=4456%2E5885482%2E4RiPFz)**

In solidarity,

Larry Cohen
Our Revolution Board Chair _\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Joseph Geevarghese, Our Revolution Executive Director _
_Date: Wed, Jul 12, 2023_
_Subject: opportunity to leverage progressive power_ Peter Willis,

**We have a concrete plan of action to leverage progressive power heading into 2024 - when progressives will be a key voting bloc that can’t be ignored.** As a long-time organizer, I’ve been at the forefront of critical fights and felt the thrill of winning big as well as the heartbreak of missed opportunities. That’s why I wanted to personally reach out today about our mission in this moment.

Many people are understandably feeling frustrated and betrayed by politicians, but we cannot lose strength and solidarity — **especially when we have a clear path to victory on critical issues** that raise the standard of living for working-class Americans.

**_[Will you invest in our deep organizing now by becoming a MOVEMENT BUILDER and help us sustain our fight during the next 6 months?](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8874?t=9&akid=4456%2E5885482%2E4RiPFz)_**

Organizing for transformative change isn’t easy - and it requires financial resources to recruit and train good organizers to mobilize the grassroots to keep fighting the corporate class.

As we get ready for 2024, your recurring donation - whether it’s just $5 or $10 a month - is a meaningful investment that will sustain our work in all of these areas:
* **Cancel Student Debt** \- Joe Biden made a promise, and we’re not going to allow the right-wing Supreme Court to get the last word on the issue. That’s why we’re ramping up pressure on the President to deliver for **45 million student debtors** and their families in 2024. This week, our members shared their powerful stories with Rep. Ro Khanna at the Our Revolution Town Hall, and we’re **organizing our members to testify** at an important student debt hearing at the Department of Education on Tuesday.

**[Your monthly donation helps our organizers do the work of making sure these brave advocates are heard at this turning point when student debt relief hangs in the balance.](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8874?t=10&akid=4456%2E5885482%2E4RiPFz)**
* **Raise the Wage** \- Our Revolution is partnering with One Fair Wage to put a **$20+ MINIMUM WAGE** on the ballot in critical swing states like OH and AZ in 2024. Not only will this motivate our voters to the polls, but it will mean millions of people getting a long overdue pay raise so they no longer have to choose between rent and groceries.
* **End Fossil Fuels** \- The climate fight is heating up right now as Manchin, Sinema, and the GOP prepare to double down on fossil fuel drilling in upcoming must-pass bills this fall. Right now, we’re teaming up with our allies at Greenpeace and Friends of the Earth to make sure progressives in Congress have enough votes to block Big Oil.
* **End Medical Debt & Big Pharma Price Gouging** \- Bernie is leveraging his power as HELP Chair in the Senate to block nominees in exchange for lower drug prices, and our members are organizing on the outside to stop medical debt by taking on price-gouging hospitals and predatory debt collectors. We can win this.

**[We are tackling each of these issues strategically and aggressively because these are the issues that matter most to our membership base - and Democrats cannot afford to fail in this moment. Help us win these fights with a recurring donation of $5 or $10 a month — any amount helps!](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8874?t=11&akid=4456%2E5885482%2E4RiPFz)**

We have a concrete plan to win on these issues, and we have the people on our side. We just need the resources to mobilize our grassroots movement into action and execute on our strategy.

We are more powerful than we realize, and the ruling class would love nothing more than for us to back down now. **[Let’s show them the power of our movement.](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8874?t=12&akid=4456%2E5885482%2E4RiPFz)**

When we organize, we win.

Joseph Geevarghese, Our Revolution Executive Director

As of today, Aaron Regunberg has officially qualified for the ballot in Rhode Island’s 1st Congressional District! | | | Peter, we wanted to take a quick second to update you on one of the biggest races of the year — Rhode Island’s 1st Congressional District, where Rep. David Cicilline’s retirement gives us a rare off-year opportunity to send a bold progressive to the House of Representatives. **As of today, WFP champion and candidate for RI-01 Aaron Regunberg has officially collected enough signatures to qualify for the ballot!** We know that Aaron is the kind of transformative leader who can make this a country where everyone can thrive — and his record speaks for itself. As a community organizer, he founded an education justice organization to empower students and improve our public schools. As a state representative, he championed massive wins of sick days, better wages, and green energy for the people of Rhode Island. And as a climate lawyer, he worked to hold Big Oil accountable and defend our planet from greedy corporations. **With the primary less than two months away, we need to get to work making sure every voter in Rhode Island’s 1st Congressional District knows how Aaron will fight for them. Dear Peter,
My opponent Democrat Marie Perez voted against an amendment to the National Defense Authorization Act that would ban funding for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) programs in the military.
DEI is a divisive, racialized policy that undermines the strength of our armed forces by replacing our military's meritocracy with sex, race, and sexual orientation based promotions and advancement.
As the New York Post reported, the greatest threat to our military isn't Russia or China, but these destructive DEI policies.
If you believe we need to send Republicans who will fight against woke B.S. in the military, please help me get to Washington by contributing to my campaign at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/XGOpqTfm9c4OUOujs0ZVmQ/43892SENMGL31JB8928ZRP8RQg).
I spent 20 years in our Special Forces. I know how important it is that the stripes or bars on a serviceman or woman's shoulders are earned because of talent, fortitude, and courage - and not because of some sex- or race-based grievance.
Already Biden's DEI policies are discouraging talented soldiers, sailors, airmen, and marines from re-enlisting and it's pushing our recruitment numbers to all-time lows.
When I get to DC, I promise to tear DEI out root and branch from our military, our government, our corporations, and our educational institutions.

| | If unidentified flying objects (UFOs) don’t exist, what in the wide-open galaxy is the government working overtime to keep under lock and key? Every time we hold a hearing about this topic, the Pentagon sends some blubbering fool who can't even spell UFO. It's high time we set the record straight and release the extraterrestrial footage, reports, and anything else that doesn’t compromise our national security. I recently proposed some changes to the National Defense Authorization Act of 2024, and I’m over the moon because UAP (Unidentified Aerial Phenomena) declassification will be included. UAP is their fancy new term for UFO, but to put it simply, they’re going to open up the secret files and let us see what’s actually going on out there. We have [decorated veterans](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvK8pIY8ybS9KyNU6BrR1f6juZh2LX7dT61CjW_S4I2xL7zwJWEn9WNdhJgvfhZzIdAhO02JTb7SmkB6KuX8L55HlrRAEoNSVxTK6laSZqcWeCFd2URkCRJcdvVX6J6PZ5gmRcXX2mNa1kBBVx0Z4PiGIkwgQlqDE4lh02VNxtUNEVCyub-2HEZc75OatQ6Hq5KYCURmcjHBcEm4KMQnkzqm50qBZ7YJN7tGdM3LYZiSRIJfM7CkhuA9ASxElzDhtZSTPsGRzkJERtUTuTsOAlvW9TLNWfeolYUSsaOpqLe_OrQN-NIlDRaFRy5hhmmNtFUg%3D%3D) bravely speaking out about their firsthand experiences. Call me crazy, but I’m going to trust their accounts before I believe a bunch of Washington bureaucrats who will use this as an excuse to ask for more cash. We don’t need to funnel [billions of dollars](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvK8pIY8ybS9KyNU6BrR1f6jtAKwqsNzzAlBlLDcWRave6Sa-W38ryvFPCCwusvaLaoSXONQ8wrOj5YMSUg4A455M_uYYa6BqO3-YDHSFaMKerWWQx9rpJKQxxAlm0MK_LVetEui2quxp8BU0bMQUP7yZ0Xz_lqf8ZHboVc0BqEUYNEFDUetbYDztIXE-JdhetSOCIv1osLyDjX0WJLHXjri5iaMikD9IVyAK_mvmK2_OAlyU4hQ9WBj3ZDJNRPN_pDxnkZxtPE0uLs_F7T7YoYXVa61EVAjmloZ8NGVnFa_3w) into “studying” these things, we need to prioritize the voices of those who served and witnessed these very real events. Let's be frank, the UFOs they saw aren't from Russia or the Communist Chinese, as some have suggested. We all know they’d land a spacecraft on the White House lawn if they could. These unidentified objects have no heat trail—and they’re coming from somewhere beyond our realm. No more secrets or funny business. Americans deserve to see the [otherworldly evidence](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvKwdJdaR1_Y4hRHCyK6oOyJROp1-0z0UqhjdG9TxaPwvaw5lVqXx7ejz7NkKTMwjUcu37_m5Hw4JwkuJKcx8ZuTMY8bo_yXflUkA28sSihLToT3r8QEt5j0T1a2vNtPBRXUdO6Iptd53w08MFcHfHyNEitIvf_mxb1ilgZwxhHI2EghmdzeH7Npi8yExXrN4J9Jf7vesCzYMCjVEbbNrZYLvcj2jzwEwtikOzgLk53j8djujR4EvdCwnAQOB0vZF9nQ%3D%3D) for themselves.

| | I guess the secret’s out about my stellar baseball skills after they were [on full display](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvK9zXzfxoWEy4s06X94K_bZtAFQ93S6Qy1nw4AVh9lKWe9Yqe_4yjveGhOT1KDVARwY6lgHUD1563eSWbfuVmpmBkhDGU9IVQ6G8olfqrOO1KwqQDFXRvEwBC2-nEOMQrUfvqEbvwAG_fdRfetzWHGr19qn6hV_dK3yyss6M64BQRUQvcEKWK6XNsnvJIg3s5PT5pYe-SBYXNECqvhLwPnemfUgmC-J-rNZwoXrB3fzSN) at the Congressional Baseball Game. I was invited to throw out the first pitch for the [Tennessee Vintage Base Ball Association](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvK7xQZLie-3WZ9cyk6yr19b9SS4e32ctJ6ZGetsQweOFAbxac5DBlf-EDfWHAS-SzoICQSHuo_2O0-OgNxSoJ38LolxW2TzFOUa2vp-KL8nM3OSeLY1kOmIjlQ7eqGtOLEbsryhamrdv-9KUM0LBNQw1DMgfzvLGCssacnLY0XKP5PXtnAEFvFQG37eKwPsL0GR-3hyDx6CuDZwvCr2yzQWVrjhgNPraTwE6Eyu4QzlbOax0-s0WGk4U5ZTAeboRpQw%3D%3D) game, held at the Historic Ramsey House. This event was a Veterans Appreciation Day that gave our nation’s heroes a chance to receive well-deserved recognition and a few special perks. Naturally, I was thrilled to show my support for this great cause. The association is all about offering a look back in time to see how baseball was played in the 1800s, replicating everything from the equipment to the uniforms used back then. Their commitment to bringing history to life is impressive, and I thoroughly enjoyed being a part of it all. Although I must admit, it’s a shame that my [underhanded pitch](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=541b3ffe22fd4ceab8fa63e9431c014f&_e=6e3bvPpvof_ucWZyATdvK7V2uMtc2wKw9ZcXLE7RkLvWcgCI_GWfJJpFQmK_S8ishm1W0iynvL-v2wVnzjVI-FUTdVHuOAYcoGrfrk_Bn7sV7fVJ4xT4NKno1-OAhhP4RGjQ7R2O1fyIkj1-EIx_Wzl4b7qPm5KG2vbCitwcEN_LuUz60ctQn82mySSvDgZCSybtOjnGl-cuBVjAqFa0WYpFUALxAi_uFBSm8i5EiUzLUyeneKw5oZtdWKNkqWaM) probably still hadn’t been invented during that period.

* Clarence Thomas voted for the Muslim ban while his wife worked for an organization supporting the ban.
* He voted against holding Trump accountable for the Jan 6th insurrection, after his wife actively advocated to overturn 2020’s election results (including directly pushing Trump’s Chief of Staff).
* He voted against the _Affordable Care Act_ while his wife was paid to lobby for its repeal.
* He voted to stop vote recounts in the 2000 presidential election while his wife was working with George W. Bush’s transition team.

These are just some of the ways Justice Clarence Thomas has abused his power on the nation’s highest court to harm our communities.

It’s been just over a year since Dobbs.
| | |
---
Derek, it’s been just over a year since Dobbs.

Like so many of us, I was devastated and furious on that horrible day, when decades of work by far-right activists resulted in the shocking reversal of our right as women to make decisions about our own health.
In the year since, we’ve seen Republican legislatures across the country curtail abortion access and we’re seeing the same thing in Congress (more on that in an upcoming email). I believe this setback is temporary. **We can restore women’s reproductive health by doing what our opponents did – fighting tactically today and taking strategic actions in the years to come.**
In the short-term, we fight back at every step and hold Republicans accountable for pursuing policies that an overwhelming majority of Americans oppose. We call out Senator Tommy Tuberville and hold his colleagues accountable for his actions which risk – don’t just listen to me, listen to our nation’s military leaders – undermining our national security.
And we do the hard work of registering voters and improving our targeting so the right messages are reaching the right people. We restore Democratic majorities a few seats at a time – only five to retake the U.S. House! – and we outwork the other side so we’re better prepared for the next round of redistricting, which will be here before you know it.

Will you join me in this fight and in doing this hard but critical work?

# Join Me In The Fight For Our Community
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | I'm reaching out today because I need your support in my campaign to fight for every neighborhood in CA-42. With a proven track record as an organizer and advocate on Capitol Hill, I have dedicated my life to championing causes that matter to the people we serve.
I've faced challenges throughout my journey, but I've never been one to back down.
In my work to establish a Smithsonian American Latino Museum, reverse the unjust Muslim travel ban imposed by the previous administration, and secure much-needed aid for Puerto Rico after the devastating Hurricane María, I witnessed the roadblocks that some politicians placed to keep the doors of power shut.
But I refuse to let that discourage me.
I firmly believe that the voices and stories of those most affected by injustices must be heard. That's why I am committed to fighting for representation and equality, ensuring that the concerns and dreams of our community are at the forefront of decision-making.
Together, we can prove the gatekeepers wrong. We have the power to make a difference by showing them that CA-42 is united, vocal, and demanding real change. Our collective voice will challenge the status quo and push for policies that empower us all to not just survive but thrive.
But, my friend, I cannot do this alone. I need your support to bring our vision to life. Your contribution, no matter the size, will make a significant impact on our campaign's success. Whether it's [$5](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/9aObMEwQ_/c?w=ETFA9um8lIweZvvg8h7ft9S-5jQ2itgq2WWTCQAMRfg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3ZvdGVmb3Jsb3BleiIsInIiOiJkZWQ4OTQ4MS03NjI4LTRiMDAtMTdmOC1iM2VjMzFkMmEwYTAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0YWVkNzQ0ZS1kYzNhLTRlMGItYWFmNS02YWZjMTc3NGRmZTMifQ), [$50](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/9aObMEwQ_/c?w=ETFA9um8lIweZvvg8h7ft9S-5jQ2itgq2WWTCQAMRfg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3ZvdGVmb3Jsb3BleiIsInIiOiJkZWQ4OTQ4MS03NjI4LTRiMDAtMTdmOC1iM2VjMzFkMmEwYTAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0YWVkNzQ0ZS1kYzNhLTRlMGItYWFmNS02YWZjMTc3NGRmZTMifQ), or [$500](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/9aObMEwQ_/c?w=ETFA9um8lIweZvvg8h7ft9S-5jQ2itgq2WWTCQAMRfg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3ZvdGVmb3Jsb3BleiIsInIiOiJkZWQ4OTQ4MS03NjI4LTRiMDAtMTdmOC1iM2VjMzFkMmEwYTAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0YWVkNzQ0ZS1kYzNhLTRlMGItYWFmNS02YWZjMTc3NGRmZTMifQ), your donation will directly support our efforts to fight for the issues that matter most to our community.
In addition to financial contributions, [I urge you to join our passionate team of volunteers. Together, we can knock on doors, make phone calls, and spread the word about our mission](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/9aObMEwQ_/c?w=Kg68UvFvupExe5O3EufVt2JNX7Mokp2wQhyvrb95afE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmljb2xlbG9wZXpmb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb20vIiwiciI6ImRlZDg5NDgxLTc2MjgtNGIwMC0xN2Y4LWIzZWMzMWQyYTBhMCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjRhZWQ3NDRlLWRjM2EtNGUwYi1hYWY1LTZhZmMxNzc0ZGZlMyJ9). By engaging with our community directly, we will build a powerful movement that cannot be ignored. Every dollar and every hour you contribute brings us one step closer to achieving our shared goals.
Together, we will prove that change is possible when we stand up, speak out, and fight for what we deserve.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

## Republicans See Major Wins during the 2023 Legislative Session
---
| Last fall in Hastings, the Nebraska Republican Party State Central Committee met and adopted the “**LEGISLATIVE PLAN FOR NEBRASKA** , 108th Legislature, 1st Regular Session, 2023.” [Click here](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a07f376eaf&e=25844e23a8). The NEGOP constitution requires a Legislative Plan and it was adopted with overwhelming support by the NEGOP state central committee members from across Nebraska. The purpose of the Legislative Plan was to build a framework for communication and networking with our state senators on core values and priorities to further our principles throughout Nebraska. In January we engaged in the introduction of legislation and we believe this effort brought much needed changes to improve the lives of all Nebraskans.

Now the Nebraska Legislature has adjourned, it is important that we as a party **reflect upon the success of the NEGOP Legislative Plan** and how it opened respectful conversations with senators and designed a clear path for Republican winning at the Unicameral. The Plan covered proposed legislation on the following issues:
---
|
## Make a Strong Economy that Works for All Nebraskans
---
| **WIN **\- Reduce the burden of local property taxes by increasing state aid and curtailing spending
**[LB583 (Sanders) Provide foundation aid and special ed supplemental aid under](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=267c2f688b&e=25844e23a8)**[**TEEOSA**](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7d0d87fb4c&e=25844e23a8)
**[LB589 (Briese) Adopt School District Property Tax Limitation Act](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=105e39fc91&e=25844e23a8)**
**[LB243 (Briese) Change minimum amount of relief granted under the Property Tax Credit Act](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=e28edab10b&e=25844e23a8)

WIN **\- Provide a fair and regionally competitive personal and corporate state income tax rate
**[LB754 (Linehan) Reduce individual and corporate income tax rates](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=6286f624ab&e=25844e23a8) **

## Commitment to Prolife and Constitutional Freedoms
---
| **WIN **\- Protect the unborn child, restrict abortion, and honor the sanctity of every human life
**[LB574 (Kauth) Adopt the Let Them Grow Act and the Preborn Child Protection Act](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=ef9e4bdf8e&e=25844e23a8)**
**[LB626 (Albrecht) Adopt the Nebraska Heartbeat Act](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=705f6cb140&e=25844e23a8)

WIN **\- Defend our constitutional right to keep and bear arms, stand your ground, & self defense
**[LB77 (Brewer) Provide for carrying of concealed handguns without a permit](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=a7d109cf97&e=25844e23a8)**
---
|

|
## Give Parents Control over their Children’s Education
---
| **WIN **\- Empower parents in selecting the school their child attends by funding school choice
**[LB753 (Linehan) Adopt the Opportunity Scholarships Act and provide tax credits](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=681ecd98a0&e=25844e23a8)**
---
|
---
|
## Provide Safe Communities So Our Families Can Thrive Without Fear
---
| **WIN **\- Address poverty and mental health issues that are impacting our urban & rural areas
**[LB705 (Murman) Change provisions for distribution of lottery funds used for education](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7bfa8c430d&e=25844e23a8)**
**[LB585 (Hughes) Change duty of state school security director and require behavioral training](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=50cbdb1c00&e=25844e23a8)**
---
|
---
|
## Grow Our Agricultural, Industry and Expand Energy Production
---
| **WIN **\- Provide for affordable energy and make Nebraska more energy independent
**[LB562 (Dorn) Adopt E-15 Access Standard Act and change Beginning Farmer Tax Credit Act](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=04a74b30d5&e=25844e23a8)

WIN **\- Build a premier infrastructure system including roads, bridges, pipelines, and broadband
**[LB683 (Transportation) Create the Nebraska Broadband Office and provide duties](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1edeb879b7&e=25844e23a8) **
**[LB727 (Linehan) Change sales and use tax exemption on purchases by state and public entities](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9441b0e9b3&e=25844e23a8)**

|

|

---
| **WIN **\- Make available online video recordings of all floor debate and hearings within 24 hours
**[LB254 (Brewer) Provide and change requirements relating to video coverage of the Legislature](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8a290f3dc8&e=25844e23a8)**
---
|
---
|
## In Conclusion
---
| **We congratulate the stalwart efforts** of our Republican state senators in adopting and enacting many aspects of your **[Nebraska Republican Party Legislative Plan](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b3e7bc822d&e=25844e23a8). **

During the 2023 session, hundreds of Nebraska Republican Party members participated in testifying at committee hearings, meeting with the elected officials, phone calling and sending emails in support of your legislative plan. Weekly emails were sent by the NEGOP to alert our members on legislative action. We appreciate and applaud our members’ grassroots effort to effectuate positive change for Nebraska! Sincerely, “Thank You” to the hundreds who drove many miles and spent many hours being leaders who cared about the future of Nebraska.

**Much was accomplished in 2023, but there is still much work to be done** in anticipation of the 2024 legislative session. The drafting of a new **“2024 NEGOP Legislative Plan”** is in the works and, per our constitution, must be completed by the NEGOP Executive Committee by September 1st.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/66511617/416594691/-2113420158?source=EM_NBI_JP_20230713_ST_RoevWade_0_3MO_Jimmy_NA_NA_RoevWade&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzI0YzliYi05NjIyLWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C__DeXXS3C0glGP5N4S8Uo6Tjd2PCdguRI0LvKTucAw=&emci=bebf90b2-9021-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=8724c9bb-9622-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=6108787) | Peter,

It’s been more than a year since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, stripping away a woman’s right to make her own reproductive health care choices. As of today, 24 states have moved to ban or restrict a woman’s choice for reproductive health care, putting millions of women at risk by putting access to proper health care out of reach.

This decision not only impedes a woman’s right to choose but interferes with access to other medication and imperils our privacy-based rights. These issues reflect our basic civil liberties, and I’m ready to push for policies and programs that put the power back in the hands of people, not politicians.

My colleagues and I have been working tirelessly on legislative action to reverse the damage caused by overturning Roe v. Wade. Last month, I worked to bring the Women’s Health Protection Act to a vote so that we can protect a woman's right to choose and health care providers who provide medical services.

I am also a part of the Pro-Choice Caucus that is working to address issues critical to women’s health, including contraception, family planning, preventive services, and access to reproductive health care.

We are grateful to live in a state that continues to protect our rights, but our fight doesn’t end here. We must continue fighting for the millions of women who were affected by the reversal of Roe v. Wade and to ensure that every woman has the right to choose.

Sincerely,

Jimmy

Peter,

Since John McCain’s passing in 2018, Arizona has been in political turmoil. We’ve had two high-profile Senate elections in the past 4 years with** more than $340 MILLION **spent to persuade voters to cast their ballot for a particular candidate.

**As Sheriff of Arizona’s 3rd largest county,** I can only dream of what me and my team of deputies would be able to do with $340 million. I’ll tell you this: _**there would be no illegal immigrants on the loose in the entire county I’m responsible for protecting.**
_
Unfortunately, the days of raising - and spending - massive sums of money to win a Senate seat are here to stay. I knew that when I got into the race, but it doesn’t mean I like it. But in my mind’s eye, **the endless hours we’ll spend fundraising to build my profile are worth it**. The Democrats I’m running against are as progressive as they come and completely out of touch with the average American voter.

Unfortunately for me, **campaign cash comes easier for Democrats**. In the first quarter of the year, my opponents raised more than $5 million between them. **If I’m ever going to build out the public profile I’ll need to run a competitive race against them, I’m going to have to raise some serious cash.**
